# Reading policy for the reference kernel (fixed by the orchestrator; every item is reported for arbitration)

General
- The frozen spec specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md is the only semantic source. Cite clauses as §N or §N.k (item k).
- Formalize each clause as written. Never add a clause the text does not state (no "robustness"); never drop one.
- When a clause has no checkable content in the state (undefined term), do not invent content: omit it from the definition and record it in readings.md (clause, quote, why it cannot be formalized).
- When a clause has two readings, use the one listed below; if the case is not listed, use the draft's reading if the draft matches one of the readings, and record it in readings.md with both readings and an example of a program whose verdict changes.
- A representation choice that changes no accepted program is free (record it briefly).

State (§38): S3 = (F, nF, P, I, A, D, dead, pin). No arena registry, no callParams, no freed. Library state lives elsewhere.
Outcomes (§58): one type Outcome3 σ := ok σ | reject | fail; every O1–O16 relation except alloc never yields fail.
O1 derive (§60): takes a region (List Nat, read extensionally), not a place. Preconditions: active source; ExercisableAt source mode; every leaf of region exists, is a leaf, belongs to afp source; mode ≤ effective mode of source on each leaf; §60.3 as a decidable clause (no unrelated active authority becomes incompatible); §60.4 current frame live. §60.1c "origin chain and anchors valid" and §60.4b "footprint and anchoring restrictions": no checkable content -> omitted, recorded.
O2 split (§61): draft clauses (incl. no exclusive right already distributed). §61.4 is NOT a precondition (the §61 note says an accepted split may violate I1 without DDSound) -> recorded.
O3 release (§62): draft clauses; §62.5 (abstraction contracts) omitted, recorded.
O4 transfer (§63): draft clauses MINUS the draft's extra clause "(transferEff s src dst).Usable dst" (not in §63); PLUS §63.8 (local self-blocking prevention, as LockOptions.Opt2Transfer on formal/derivability_0.1); effect: dependencies follow the corresponding places corr(r) (not all to the destination root); §63.6 over moved usable places and AnchorOrder in the resulting state; §63.7 AnchorOrderHeld for the moved held authorities in the resulting state; §63.4 = draft ActiveDerivedOutside reading (recorded); §63.2 child order = place index order (recorded).
O5 depend (§64): draft clauses; §64.2b "real dependency" omitted, recorded.
O8 store (§65): draft clauses (they match).
O9/O10/O11 (§66–§68): add "every leaf belongs to a usable place" (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1); O10 keeps §67.2 explicitly.
O12 endUse (§69): death markers transitive over owned storage; drop the draft's extra disjunct that blocks descendants of authorities the step releases (not in §69.2) -> record the consequence.
O13 free (§70): death markers transitive; no extra "Usable p" and no clearing of D beyond what §70 prescribes; §70.4 scope = the released unit (place and storage that dies with it).
O14 alloc (§71): shape nonempty with exactly ONE root (one new storage root), parts' parents inside the shape, no owner component; provider clause as written in §71.2 (Modify OR writeShared over SharedMutable metadata) -> conflict with §36 recorded; outcomes reject / fail (not Satisfiable) / ok.
O6 enterFrame (§72): locals owned directly by the new frame (no local owned by another local); §72.3 ParamOriginHidden; §72.4 AnchorOrderHeld in the resulting state.
O7 exitFrame (§73): draft (first surviving active origin, held by a frame or a usable place).
O15/O16 pin/unpin (§74, §75): per-leaf dynamic pin flags (draft); unpin requires the place usable and K.ExternalDone(place) on the place; StaticPinnedBottom is a condition on (K, statics), not on states.
HasRight / ExercisableAt (§43): one authority exercisable at m with sufficient effective mode on every leaf (∃ a, ∀ l) as the draft -> recorded.
WF3 (§49): a structure with eight named fields, one per item:
 1 frames: F nonempty, no duplicates, every frame < nF;
 2 places: parent links valid and acyclic (representation: parent index < child index), parts share the owner and death marker of their parent;
 3 owners: owner frames < nF, owner places exist; "well-founded ownership chains reaching a live frame for every usable place" read as stated for usable places (Usable is inductive) -> recorded with the global-acyclicity alternative;
 4 footprints: every footprint member is an existing leaf;
 5 authorities: origins exist and precede (origin index < id: representation of acyclic chains ending at a root);
 6 RootChain (draft);
 7 RootHeld as §49.7 states it: every usable root place has an active root authority, Modify, no origin, held by its owner, whose footprint is the place's footprint (draft RootLive + mode);
 8 holder validity (draft poss).
 The draft's converse RootHeld (every origin-less authority covering a leaf of root r is held by r's owner) is NOT a WF3 clause: keep it as a separate auxiliary predicate.
I2 (§51): mode conservation unconditional (not under ∀ p ∈ footprint).
Initial state (§47): base frame 0; statics may be owned by statics; root authority held by the owner. Well-formedness of the statics declaration (acyclic ownership, parents before children) is not stated by §47: keep the draft ShapeOK-style hypothesis as a hypothesis of the init theorems and record it as a spec gap.
Reachable: closure of S3.init statics under the kernel steps O1–O16 only.
#!/bin/bash
# usage: axcheck.sh Module.Name [Module.Name ...]   (run after lake build of those modules)
SP=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/ref
F=$SP/axcheck_$$.lean
{
  echo "import Lean"
  for m in "$@"; do echo "import $m"; done
  echo 'open Lean Elab Command in'
  echo '#eval show Lean.Core.CoreM Unit from do'
  echo '  let env ← getEnv'
  printf '  for modName in [%s] do\n' "$(printf '`%s, ' "$@" | sed 's/, $//')"
  cat <<'L'
    let some mod := env.getModuleIdx? modName | throwError "no module"
    let mut all := 0
    let mut thms := 0
    let mut bad : Array (Name × Array Name) := #[]
    for (n, ci) in env.constants.map₁.toList do
      if env.getModuleIdxFor? n == some mod then
        all := all + 1
        if let .thmInfo _ := ci then thms := thms + 1
        let axs ← collectAxioms n
        let extra := axs.filter fun a => a != ``propext && a != ``Quot.sound
        if !extra.isEmpty then bad := bad.push (n, extra)
    IO.println s!"{modName}: constants {all}, theorems {thms}"
    IO.println s!"outside propext, Quot.sound: {bad}"
L
} > $F

73	O17–O19 (§76–§78), with their arguments. -/
74	inductive Op where
75	  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
76	  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
77	  | release (a : Nat)
78	  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
79	  | depend (q x : Nat)
80	  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
81	  | exit
82	  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
83	  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
84	  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
85	  | pin (p : Nat)
86	  | unpin (p : Nat)
87	  | endUse (p : Nat)
88	  | free (p auth : Nat)
89	  | alloc (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
90	  | store (a p : Nat)
91	  | newArena (storage internal : Nat)
92	  | issue (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
93	  | reset (i : Nat)

95	/-- The verdict of an outcome (§58): `ok`, `reject` or `fail`, without the state. -/
96	inductive Verdict where
97	  | ok
98	  | reject
99	  | fail
100	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
101	
102	/-- The verdict of an outcome (§58). -/
103	def verdictOf {σ : Type} : Outcome3 σ → Verdict
104	  | .ok _ => .ok
105	  | .reject => .reject
106	  | .fail => .fail
107	
108	/-- A kernel relation (§60–§75) read on library outcomes: the kernel outcome, with the arena
109	registry `A` unchanged on `ok` (Part XIV: kernel steps of non-administrative code). -/
110	def KRel (R : Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (A : List ArenaEntry) : Outcome3 LState → Prop
111	  | .ok L' => R (.ok L'.kern) ∧ L'.arenas = A
112	  | .reject => R .reject
113	  | .fail => R .fail
114	
115	/-- The relation of operation `o` from `L` (§60–§78): the kernel relation of O1–O16 with the
116	registry unchanged; `NewArenaStep` with no other registry (§76, §56), the derived `IssueD` (§77)
117	and `ResetD` (§78). -/
118	def OpRel (k : K) (L : LState) : Op → Outcome3 LState → Prop
119	  | .derive src r m => KRel (DeriveStep src r m L.kern) L.arenas
120	  | .split src rs => KRel (SplitStep k src rs L.kern) L.arenas
121	  | .release a => KRel (ReleaseStep a L.kern) L.arenas
122	  | .transfer src dst => KRel (TransferStep k src dst L.kern) L.arenas
123	  | .depend q x => KRel (DependStep q x L.kern) L.arenas
124	  | .enter ps ls => KRel (EnterStep ps ls L.kern) L.arenas
125	  | .exit => KRel (ExitStep k L.kern) L.arenas
126	  | .read a ls => KRel (Read3Step a ls L.kern) L.arenas
127	  | .write a ls => KRel (Write3Step a ls L.kern) L.arenas
128	  | .writeShared a ls => KRel (WriteSharedStep k a ls L.kern) L.arenas
129	  | .pin p => KRel (PinStep p L.kern) L.arenas
130	  | .unpin p => KRel (UnpinStep k p L.kern) L.arenas
131	  | .endUse p => KRel (EndUseStep k p L.kern) L.arenas
132	  | .free p auth => KRel (FreeStep k p auth L.kern) L.arenas
133	  | .alloc pr ow ls => KRel (AllocStep k pr ow ls L.kern) L.arenas
134	  | .store a p => KRel (StoreStep a p L.kern) L.arenas
135	  | .newArena st i => NewArenaStep [] st i L
136	  | .issue i r d => IssueD k i r d L
137	  | .reset i => ResetD i L

139	/-! ## Executor -/
140	
141	section Exec
142	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
143	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
144	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
145	
146	/-- A guarded kernel step (§58) on a library state: `ok` with the effect and the registry
147	unchanged when the preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
148	def kg (L : LState) (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (s : S3) : Outcome3 LState :=
149	  if p then .ok ⟨s, L.arenas⟩ else .reject
150	
151	/-- The computed outcome of operation `o` from `L` (§58, §60–§78). `issue` follows `IssueD`
152	(static checks, availability `fail`, `split`, `store`); `reset` follows `ResetD` (`derive`,
153	`release`, §78.3). -/
154	def lstep (L : LState) : Op → Outcome3 LState
155	  | .derive src r m => kg L (DerivePre L.kern src r m) (deriveEff L.kern src r m)
156	  | .split src rs => kg L (SplitPre k L.kern src rs) (splitEff L.kern src rs)
157	  | .release a => kg L (ReleasePre L.kern a) (releaseEff L.kern a)
158	  | .transfer src dst => kg L (TransferPre k L.kern src dst) (transferEff L.kern src dst)
159	  | .depend q x => kg L (DependPre L.kern q x) (dependEff L.kern q x)
160	  | .enter ps ls => kg L (EnterPre L.kern ps ls) (enterEff L.kern ps ls)
161	  | .exit => kg L (ExitPre k L.kern) (exitEff L.kern)
162	  | .read a ls => kg L (Read3Pre L.kern a ls) L.kern
163	  | .write a ls => kg L (Write3Pre L.kern a ls) (write3Eff L.kern ls)
164	  | .writeShared a ls => kg L (WriteSharedPre k L.kern a ls) (write3Eff L.kern ls)
165	  | .pin p => kg L (PinPre L.kern p) (pinEff L.kern p true)
166	  | .unpin p => kg L (UnpinPre k L.kern p) (pinEff L.kern p false)
167	  | .endUse p => kg L (EndUsePre k L.kern p) (endUseEff L.kern p)
168	  | .free p auth => kg L (FreePre k L.kern p auth) (freeEff L.kern p)
169	  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
170	    if AllocStatic k L.kern pr ow ls then
171	      if k.Satisfiable pr ls L.kern then .ok ⟨allocEff L.kern ow ls, L.arenas⟩ else .fail
172	    else .reject
173	  | .store a p => kg L (StorePre L.kern a p) (storeEff L.kern a p)
174	  | .newArena st i =>
175	    if NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas [] st i then .ok (newArenaEff L st i) else .reject
176	  | .issue i r d =>
177	    match L.arenas[i]? with
178	    | none => .reject
179	    | some E =>
180	      if IssueStatic L.kern E r d then
181	        if Avail E r then
182	          if SplitPre k L.kern E.internal [r] then
183	            if StorePre (splitEff L.kern E.internal [r]) L.kern.A.length d then
184	              .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff L.kern E.internal [r]) L.kern.A.length d,
185	                L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E r)⟩
186	            else .reject
187	          else .reject
188	        else .fail
189	      else .reject
190	  | .reset i =>
191	    match L.arenas[i]? with
192	    | none => .reject
193	    | some E =>
194	      if DerivePre L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify then
195	        if ReleasePre (deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)
196	            L.kern.A.length then
197	          if ResetNoDeps L.kern E then
198	            .ok ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)
199	              L.kern.A.length, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩
200	          else .reject
201	        else .reject
202	      else .reject
203	
204	/-- The state after `o` from `L` when it is `ok`; `L` otherwise (§58). -/
205	def next (L : LState) (o : Op) : LState :=
206	  match lstep k L o with
207	  | .ok L' => L'
208	  | _ => L
209	
210	/-- The state reached by the operations `os` from `L` when every step is `ok` (§58); `none` as soon
211	as a step is not `ok`. -/
212	def lrun (L : LState) : List Op → Option LState
213	  | [] => some L
214	  | o :: os =>
215	    match lstep k L o with
216	    | .ok L' => lrun L' os
217	    | _ => none
218	
219	/-- The state reached by `os` from `LState.init statics` (§47); `LState.init statics` when a step is
220	not `ok` (used only under `(lrun …).isSome = true`, see `runsTo`). -/
221	def final (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : LState :=
222	  (lrun k (LState.init statics) os).getD (LState.init statics)
223	
224	/-- A run of `os` from `LState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `L`; `L` is
225	library-reachable (Part XIV) and its kernel state is reachable (§57). -/
226	structure RunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) (L : LState) : Prop where
227	  /-- Every step of the run is `ok` and the run ends in `L`. -/
228	  run : lrun k (LState.init statics) os = some L
229	  /-- `L` is library-reachable (Part XIV, §46). -/
230	  lreach : LReach k statics L
231	  /-- The kernel state of `L` is reachable from `S3.init statics` by O1–O16 (§57). -/
232	  reach : Reachable k statics L.kern
233	
234	/-- The run of `os` from `LState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57, Part XIV). -/
235	abbrev Runs (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : Prop :=
236	  RunsTo k statics os (final k statics os)
237	
238	end Exec

240	/-! ## Soundness -/
241	
242	/-- An `ok` outcome of a relation of `OpRel` is a library step (Part XIV, §57): a kernel step
243	O1–O16 with the registry unchanged, `newArena`, the derived `issue` or the derived `reset`. -/
244	theorem opRel_ok {k : K} {L L' : LState} : ∀ {o : Op}, OpRel k L o (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
245	  | .derive .., h | .split .., h | .release .., h | .transfer .., h | .depend .., h
246	  | .enter .., h | .exit, h | .read .., h | .write .., h | .writeShared .., h | .pin .., h
247	  | .unpin .., h | .endUse .., h | .free .., h | .alloc .., h | .store .., h => by
248	    obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := h
249	    have hL : L' = ⟨L'.kern, L.arenas⟩ := by rw [← e]
250	    rw [hL]
251	    first
252	      | exact .kernel (.derive h) | exact .kernel (.split h) | exact .kernel (.release h)
253	      | exact .kernel (.transfer h) | exact .kernel (.depend h) | exact .kernel (.enter h)
254	      | exact .kernel (.exit h) | exact .kernel (.read h) | exact .kernel (.write h)
255	      | exact .kernel (.writeShared h) | exact .kernel (.pin h) | exact .kernel (.unpin h)
256	      | exact .kernel (.endUse h) | exact .kernel (.free h) | exact .kernel (.alloc h)
257	      | exact .kernel (.store h)
258	  | .newArena .., h => .newArena h
259	  | .issue .., h => .issue h
260	  | .reset .., h => .reset h
261	
262	section Sound
263	variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
264	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
265	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
266	
267	/-- A guarded kernel step computed by `kg` is an outcome of its relation (§58). -/
268	theorem kg_sound {L : LState} {p : Prop} [Decidable p] {s : S3} :
269	    KRel (Guarded p s) L.arenas (kg L p s) := by
270	  unfold kg
271	  split
272	  · next h => exact ⟨.ok h, rfl⟩
273	  · next h => exact .reject h
274	
275	/-- **Step soundness** (§58, §60–§78): the computed outcome of `o` from `L` is an outcome of the
276	relation of `o`, `ok`, `reject` and `fail` alike. -/
277	theorem lstep_sound (L : LState) (o : Op) : OpRel k L o (lstep k L o) := by
278	  cases o with
279	  | derive => exact kg_sound
280	  | split => exact kg_sound
281	  | release => exact kg_sound
282	  | transfer => exact kg_sound
283	  | depend => exact kg_sound
284	  | enter => exact kg_sound
285	  | exit => exact kg_sound
286	  | read => exact kg_sound
287	  | write => exact kg_sound
288	  | writeShared => exact kg_sound
289	  | pin => exact kg_sound
290	  | unpin => exact kg_sound
291	  | endUse => exact kg_sound
292	  | free => exact kg_sound
293	  | store => exact kg_sound
294	  | alloc pr ow ls =>
295	    show KRel (AllocStep k pr ow ls L.kern) L.arenas _
296	    dsimp only [lstep]
297	    split
298	    · next h =>
299	      split
300	      · next hs => exact ⟨.ok h hs, rfl⟩
301	      · next hs => exact .fail h hs
302	    · next h => exact .reject h
303	  | newArena st i =>
304	    show NewArenaStep [] st i L _
305	    dsimp only [lstep]
306	    split
307	    · next h => exact .ok h
308	    · next h => exact .reject h
309	  | issue i r d =>
310	    show IssueD k i r d L _
311	    dsimp only [lstep]
312	    split
313	    · next hE => exact .noEntry hE
314	    · next E hE =>
315	      split
316	      · next h1 =>
317	        split
318	        · next h2 =>
319	          split
320	          · next h3 =>
321	            split
322	            · next h4 => exact .ok hE h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.ok h4)
323	            · next h4 => exact .store hE h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.reject h4)
324	          · next h3 => exact .split hE h1 h2 (.reject h3)
325	        · next h2 => exact .fail hE h1 h2
326	      · next h1 => exact .static hE h1
327	  | reset i =>
328	    show ResetD i L _
329	    dsimp only [lstep]
330	    split
331	    · next hE => exact .noEntry hE
332	    · next E hE =>
333	      split
334	      · next h1 =>
335	        split
336	        · next h2 =>
337	          split
338	          · next h3 => exact .ok hE (.ok h1) (.ok h2) h3
339	          · next h3 => exact .contract hE (.ok h1) (.ok h2) h3
340	        · next h2 => exact .release hE (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
341	      · next h1 => exact .derive hE (.reject h1)
342	
343	/-- An `ok` computed step is a library step (Part XIV, §58). -/
344	theorem lstep_ok {L L' : LState} {o : Op} (h : lstep k L o = .ok L') : LStep k L L' :=
345	  opRel_ok (h ▸ lstep_sound L o)
346	
347	/-- A run whose steps are all `ok`, from a library-reachable state, ends in a library-reachable
348	state (Part XIV, §46). -/
349	theorem lrun_reach {statics : Statics} :
350	    ∀ {L L' : LState} {os : List Op}, LReach k statics L → lrun k L os = some L' →
351	      LReach k statics L'
352	  | _, _, [], hL, h => by cases h; exact hL
353	  | L, _, o :: os, hL, h => by
354	    unfold lrun at h
355	    cases hs : lstep k L o with
356	    | ok L₁ => rw [hs] at h; exact lrun_reach (.step hL (lstep_ok hs)) h
357	    | reject => rw [hs] at h; cases h
358	    | fail => rw [hs] at h; cases h
359	
360	/-- **Run soundness** (§47, §57, Part XIV): when every step of `os` from `LState.init statics` is
361	`ok`, the run reaches `final k statics os`, which is library-reachable and whose kernel state is
362	reachable by O1–O16. -/
363	theorem runsTo {statics : Statics} {os : List Op}
364	    (h : (lrun k (LState.init statics) os).isSome = true) : Runs k statics os := by
365	  have hr : lrun k (LState.init statics) os = some (final k statics os) := by
366	    unfold final
367	    cases e : lrun k (LState.init statics) os with
368	    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
369	    | some L => rfl
370	  have hl := lrun_reach .init hr
371	  exact ⟨hr, hl, hl.ng.reachable⟩
372	
373	/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
374	theorem rejects {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .reject) :
375	    OpRel k L o .reject := by
376	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
377	  revert hs h
378	  cases lstep k L o with
379	  | ok => intro h; cases h
380	  | reject => intro _ hs; exact hs
381	  | fail => intro h; cases h
382	
383	/-- A computed `fail` is a `fail` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
384	theorem fails {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .fail) :
385	    OpRel k L o .fail := by
386	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
387	  revert hs h
388	  cases lstep k L o with
389	  | ok => intro h; cases h
390	  | reject => intro h; cases h
391	  | fail => intro _ hs; exact hs
392	
393	/-- A computed `ok` is the `ok` outcome of the relation to `next k L o` (§58). -/
394	theorem oks {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .ok) :
395	    OpRel k L o (.ok (next k L o)) := by
396	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
397	  unfold next
398	  revert hs h
399	  cases lstep k L o with
400	  | ok => intro _ hs; exact hs
401	  | reject => intro h; cases h
402	  | fail => intro h; cases h
403	
404	end Sound

73	/-- The preconditions of `transfer` other than local self-blocking prevention (§63.1–§63.7), the
74	fields of `TransferPre` but `noSelfLock`: used to show that §63.8 alone rejects a transfer. -/
75	def TransferPreBut638 (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
76	  s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
77	    SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
78	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
79	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
80	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
81	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
82	    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
83	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
84	        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
85	          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True)
86	
87	/-- Decidability of `TransferPreBut638` (§63). -/
88	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
89	    Decidable (TransferPreBut638 k s src dst) := by
90	  unfold TransferPreBut638; infer_instance

93	the fields of `IssueStatic` but `dstNotIn`: used to show that this clause alone rejects. -/
94	def IssueStaticBut (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
95	  s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
96	    s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
97	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
98	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
99	    HasRight s .modify dst

102	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :

664	/-- **H45** (material §1 H, class Lib). Two arena nodes `A` (5: data 6, link 7) and `B` (8: data
665	9, link 10) in the storage 4, issued to 2 and 3; `A.link` holds a view (7) on `B.data`, `B.link`
666	holds a view (8) on `A.data`; teardown (`release` of both views, `endUse` of both node values),
667	then `reset`. Expected (material): `ok` throughout. Obtained: `ok` at every step (§65, §62, §69,
668	§78, §88). -/
669	theorem H45 : Runs K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
670	    .alloc 1 0 [lf, pt 4, pt 5, pt 5, pt 4, pt 8, pt 8], .write 0 [0], .newArena 4 4,
671	    .issue 0 [6, 7] 2, .issue 0 [9, 10] 3, .derive 6 [9] .modify, .store 7 7,
672	    .derive 5 [6] .modify, .store 8 10, .release 7, .release 8, .endUse 2, .endUse 3,
673	    .reset 0] :=
674	  runsTo (by decide)
675	
676	/-- **H46** (material §1 H, class N3). A view on a local array (0: 1, 2) stored into a field (4)
677	of a local structure (3), read, then released. Expected (material): `ok`. Obtained: `ok` (§65,
678	§66, §62). -/
679	theorem H46 : Runs K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, pt 0, pt 0, lf, pt 3], .write 0 [1, 2],
680	    .derive 0 [1, 2] .observe, .store 2 4, .read 2 [1], .release 2] :=
681	  runsTo (by decide)
682	
683	/-- **H47** (material §1 H, class N3). Field-by-field transfer of a partially initialized
684	aggregate: the written field 1 of structure 0 is transferred into the field 4 of structure 3.
685	Expected (material): `ok`. Obtained: `ok` (§63 last paragraph). -/
686	theorem H47 : Runs K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, pt 0, pt 0, lf, pt 3, pt 3], .write 0 [1],
687	    .transfer 1 4] :=
688	  runsTo (by decide)
689	
690	/-! ## I. Progress -/
691	
692	/-- Common arena of section I (§71, §76, §77): frame 1 with arena value 0, allocator 1, values 2
693	and 3; storage 4 (nodes 5, 6) owned by 0, `internal` 4; block 5 on `[5]` to 2 and block 6 on
694	`[6]` to 3. -/
695	def fao : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1], .alloc 1 0 [lf, pt 4, pt 4],
696	  .write 0 [0], .newArena 4 4, .issue 0 [5] 2, .issue 0 [6] 3]
697	/-- Run of H48 (§60, §65): 7, `Modify` on `B` (6) from its block, stored into `A` (5); 8,
698	`Modify` on `A` from its block. -/
699	def h48o : List Op := fao ++ [.derive 6 [6] .modify, .store 7 5, .derive 5 [5] .modify]
700	/-- State reached by `h48o` (§57). -/

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
2	
3	/-!
4	# Corpus runner (test module)
5	
6	A computable executor for the corpus cases of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`: the
7	kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75) and the arena operations O17–O19 of Part XIV (§76–§78), over
8	the library state of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (§46: the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena
9	registry). This module is a test module: no model module imports it.
10	
11	* `Op`: one constructor per operation, with its arguments.
12	* `lstep k L o`: the outcome (§58) of `o` from `L`, computed from the decidable preconditions.
13	* `OpRel k L o`: the relation of the operation: the kernel relation `XStep` (§60–§75) with the
14	  registry unchanged; `NewArenaStep`, `IssueD`, `ResetD` (Part XIV) for the arena operations.
15	* `lstep_sound`: the computed outcome is an outcome of the relation, `ok`, `reject` and `fail`
16	  alike; `lstep_ok`: an `ok` step is a library step `LStep`.
17	* `lrun`, `final`, `RunsTo`: a run from `LState.init statics` (§47) whose steps are all `ok` reaches
18	  a library-reachable state (`LReach`) whose kernel state is reachable (`Reachable`, §57).
19	
20	`newArena` consults the arena registry and no other registry (§56: `others = []`): the library
21	states of these runs hold no administration other than arenas.
22	-/
23	
24	namespace Ern.Corpus
25	
26	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
27	
28	/-! ## Test contracts (§48, §80) -/
29	
30	/-- A test contract `K` given by lists (§48): the `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone` and
31	`Deallocable` sets, and the `FreeCompat` pairs. Nothing is declared disjoint; every allocation
32	request is satisfiable. -/
33	structure KD where
34	  shared : List Nat := []
35	  pinned : List Nat := []
36	  done : List Nat := []
37	  dealloc : List Nat := []
38	  compat : List (Nat × Nat) := []
39	
40	/-- The contract `K` (§48) described by a `KD`. -/
41	def KD.toK (d : KD) : K :=
42	  ⟨fun _ _ => False, (· ∈ d.shared), (· ∈ d.pinned), (· ∈ d.done), (· ∈ d.dealloc),
43	    fun p a => (p, a) ∈ d.compat, fun _ _ _ => True⟩
44	
45	/-- Decidability of `DeclaredDisjoint` for a test contract (§48). -/
46	instance (d : KD) : ∀ r r', Decidable (d.toK.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
47	  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
48	/-- Decidability of `SharedMutable` for a test contract (§48). -/
49	instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.SharedMutable :=
50	  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ d.shared))
51	/-- Decidability of `Pinned` for a test contract (§48). -/
52	instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.Pinned :=
53	  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ d.pinned))
54	/-- Decidability of `ExternalDone` for a test contract (§48). -/
55	instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.ExternalDone :=
56	  fun p => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∈ d.done))
57	/-- Decidability of `Deallocable` for a test contract (§48). -/
58	instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.Deallocable :=
59	  fun p => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∈ d.dealloc))
60	/-- Decidability of `FreeCompat` for a test contract (§48). -/
61	instance (d : KD) : ∀ p a, Decidable (d.toK.FreeCompat p a) :=
62	  fun p a => inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((p, a) ∈ d.compat))
63	/-- Decidability of `Satisfiable` for a test contract (§48). -/
64	instance (d : KD) : ∀ p ls s, Decidable (d.toK.Satisfiable p ls s) :=
65	  fun _ _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
66	
67	/-- Test contracts satisfy `DDSound` (§61, §80): nothing is declared disjoint. -/
68	theorem KD.ddSound (d : KD) : DDSound d.toK := fun _ _ h => h.elim
69	
70	/-! ## Operations and outcomes (§58, §60–§78) -/
71	
72	/-- An operation of a corpus run: the kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75) and the arena operations
73	O17–O19 (§76–§78), with their arguments. -/
74	inductive Op where
75	  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
76	  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
77	  | release (a : Nat)
78	  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
79	  | depend (q x : Nat)
80	  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
81	  | exit
82	  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
83	  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
84	  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
85	  | pin (p : Nat)
86	  | unpin (p : Nat)
87	  | endUse (p : Nat)
88	  | free (p auth : Nat)
89	  | alloc (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
90	  | store (a p : Nat)
91	  | newArena (storage internal : Nat)
92	  | issue (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
93	  | reset (i : Nat)
94	
95	/-- The verdict of an outcome (§58): `ok`, `reject` or `fail`, without the state. -/
96	inductive Verdict where
97	  | ok
98	  | reject
99	  | fail
100	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
101	
102	/-- The verdict of an outcome (§58). -/
103	def verdictOf {σ : Type} : Outcome3 σ → Verdict
104	  | .ok _ => .ok
105	  | .reject => .reject
106	  | .fail => .fail
107	
108	/-- A kernel relation (§60–§75) read on library outcomes: the kernel outcome, with the arena
109	registry `A` unchanged on `ok` (Part XIV: kernel steps of non-administrative code). -/
110	def KRel (R : Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (A : List ArenaEntry) : Outcome3 LState → Prop
111	  | .ok L' => R (.ok L'.kern) ∧ L'.arenas = A
112	  | .reject => R .reject
113	  | .fail => R .fail
114	
115	/-- The relation of operation `o` from `L` (§60–§78): the kernel relation of O1–O16 with the
116	registry unchanged; `NewArenaStep` with no other registry (§76, §56), the derived `IssueD` (§77)
117	and `ResetD` (§78). -/
118	def OpRel (k : K) (L : LState) : Op → Outcome3 LState → Prop
119	  | .derive src r m => KRel (DeriveStep src r m L.kern) L.arenas
120	  | .split src rs => KRel (SplitStep k src rs L.kern) L.arenas
121	  | .release a => KRel (ReleaseStep a L.kern) L.arenas
122	  | .transfer src dst => KRel (TransferStep k src dst L.kern) L.arenas
123	  | .depend q x => KRel (DependStep q x L.kern) L.arenas
124	  | .enter ps ls => KRel (EnterStep ps ls L.kern) L.arenas
125	  | .exit => KRel (ExitStep k L.kern) L.arenas
126	  | .read a ls => KRel (Read3Step a ls L.kern) L.arenas
127	  | .write a ls => KRel (Write3Step a ls L.kern) L.arenas
128	  | .writeShared a ls => KRel (WriteSharedStep k a ls L.kern) L.arenas
129	  | .pin p => KRel (PinStep p L.kern) L.arenas
130	  | .unpin p => KRel (UnpinStep k p L.kern) L.arenas
131	  | .endUse p => KRel (EndUseStep k p L.kern) L.arenas
132	  | .free p auth => KRel (FreeStep k p auth L.kern) L.arenas
133	  | .alloc pr ow ls => KRel (AllocStep k pr ow ls L.kern) L.arenas
134	  | .store a p => KRel (StoreStep a p L.kern) L.arenas
135	  | .newArena st i => NewArenaStep [] st i L
136	  | .issue i r d => IssueD k i r d L
137	  | .reset i => ResetD i L
138	
139	/-! ## Executor -/
140	
141	section Exec
142	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
143	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
144	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
145	
146	/-- A guarded kernel step (§58) on a library state: `ok` with the effect and the registry
147	unchanged when the preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
148	def kg (L : LState) (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (s : S3) : Outcome3 LState :=
149	  if p then .ok ⟨s, L.arenas⟩ else .reject
150	
151	/-- The computed outcome of operation `o` from `L` (§58, §60–§78). `issue` follows `IssueD`
152	(static checks, availability `fail`, `split`, `store`); `reset` follows `ResetD` (`derive`,
153	`release`, §78.3). -/
154	def lstep (L : LState) : Op → Outcome3 LState
155	  | .derive src r m => kg L (DerivePre L.kern src r m) (deriveEff L.kern src r m)
156	  | .split src rs => kg L (SplitPre k L.kern src rs) (splitEff L.kern src rs)
157	  | .release a => kg L (ReleasePre L.kern a) (releaseEff L.kern a)
158	  | .transfer src dst => kg L (TransferPre k L.kern src dst) (transferEff L.kern src dst)
159	  | .depend q x => kg L (DependPre L.kern q x) (dependEff L.kern q x)
160	  | .enter ps ls => kg L (EnterPre L.kern ps ls) (enterEff L.kern ps ls)
161	  | .exit => kg L (ExitPre k L.kern) (exitEff L.kern)
162	  | .read a ls => kg L (Read3Pre L.kern a ls) L.kern
163	  | .write a ls => kg L (Write3Pre L.kern a ls) (write3Eff L.kern ls)
164	  | .writeShared a ls => kg L (WriteSharedPre k L.kern a ls) (write3Eff L.kern ls)
165	  | .pin p => kg L (PinPre L.kern p) (pinEff L.kern p true)
166	  | .unpin p => kg L (UnpinPre k L.kern p) (pinEff L.kern p false)
167	  | .endUse p => kg L (EndUsePre k L.kern p) (endUseEff L.kern p)
168	  | .free p auth => kg L (FreePre k L.kern p auth) (freeEff L.kern p)
169	  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
170	    if AllocStatic k L.kern pr ow ls then
171	      if k.Satisfiable pr ls L.kern then .ok ⟨allocEff L.kern ow ls, L.arenas⟩ else .fail
172	    else .reject
173	  | .store a p => kg L (StorePre L.kern a p) (storeEff L.kern a p)
174	  | .newArena st i =>
175	    if NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas [] st i then .ok (newArenaEff L st i) else .reject
176	  | .issue i r d =>
177	    match L.arenas[i]? with
178	    | none => .reject
179	    | some E =>
180	      if IssueStatic L.kern E r d then
181	        if Avail E r then
182	          if SplitPre k L.kern E.internal [r] then
183	            if StorePre (splitEff L.kern E.internal [r]) L.kern.A.length d then
184	              .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff L.kern E.internal [r]) L.kern.A.length d,
185	                L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E r)⟩
186	            else .reject
187	          else .reject
188	        else .fail
189	      else .reject
190	  | .reset i =>
191	    match L.arenas[i]? with
192	    | none => .reject
193	    | some E =>
194	      if DerivePre L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify then
195	        if ReleasePre (deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)
196	            L.kern.A.length then
197	          if ResetNoDeps L.kern E then
198	            .ok ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)
199	              L.kern.A.length, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩
200	          else .reject
201	        else .reject
202	      else .reject
203	
204	/-- The state after `o` from `L` when it is `ok`; `L` otherwise (§58). -/
205	def next (L : LState) (o : Op) : LState :=
206	  match lstep k L o with
207	  | .ok L' => L'
208	  | _ => L
209	
210	/-- The state reached by the operations `os` from `L` when every step is `ok` (§58); `none` as soon
211	as a step is not `ok`. -/
212	def lrun (L : LState) : List Op → Option LState
213	  | [] => some L
214	  | o :: os =>
215	    match lstep k L o with
216	    | .ok L' => lrun L' os
217	    | _ => none
218	
219	/-- The state reached by `os` from `LState.init statics` (§47); `LState.init statics` when a step is
220	not `ok` (used only under `(lrun …).isSome = true`, see `runsTo`). -/
221	def final (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : LState :=
222	  (lrun k (LState.init statics) os).getD (LState.init statics)
223	
224	/-- A run of `os` from `LState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `L`; `L` is
225	library-reachable (Part XIV) and its kernel state is reachable (§57). -/
226	structure RunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) (L : LState) : Prop where
227	  /-- Every step of the run is `ok` and the run ends in `L`. -/
228	  run : lrun k (LState.init statics) os = some L
229	  /-- `L` is library-reachable (Part XIV, §46). -/
230	  lreach : LReach k statics L
231	  /-- The kernel state of `L` is reachable from `S3.init statics` by O1–O16 (§57). -/
232	  reach : Reachable k statics L.kern
233	
234	/-- The run of `os` from `LState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57, Part XIV). -/
235	abbrev Runs (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : Prop :=
236	  RunsTo k statics os (final k statics os)
237	
238	end Exec
239	
240	/-! ## Soundness -/
241	
242	/-- An `ok` outcome of a relation of `OpRel` is a library step (Part XIV, §57): a kernel step
243	O1–O16 with the registry unchanged, `newArena`, the derived `issue` or the derived `reset`. -/
244	theorem opRel_ok {k : K} {L L' : LState} : ∀ {o : Op}, OpRel k L o (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
245	  | .derive .., h | .split .., h | .release .., h | .transfer .., h | .depend .., h
246	  | .enter .., h | .exit, h | .read .., h | .write .., h | .writeShared .., h | .pin .., h
247	  | .unpin .., h | .endUse .., h | .free .., h | .alloc .., h | .store .., h => by
248	    obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := h
249	    have hL : L' = ⟨L'.kern, L.arenas⟩ := by rw [← e]
250	    rw [hL]
251	    first
252	      | exact .kernel (.derive h) | exact .kernel (.split h) | exact .kernel (.release h)
253	      | exact .kernel (.transfer h) | exact .kernel (.depend h) | exact .kernel (.enter h)
254	      | exact .kernel (.exit h) | exact .kernel (.read h) | exact .kernel (.write h)
255	      | exact .kernel (.writeShared h) | exact .kernel (.pin h) | exact .kernel (.unpin h)
256	      | exact .kernel (.endUse h) | exact .kernel (.free h) | exact .kernel (.alloc h)
257	      | exact .kernel (.store h)
258	  | .newArena .., h => .newArena h
259	  | .issue .., h => .issue h
260	  | .reset .., h => .reset h
261	
262	section Sound
263	variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
264	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
265	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
266	
267	/-- A guarded kernel step computed by `kg` is an outcome of its relation (§58). -/
268	theorem kg_sound {L : LState} {p : Prop} [Decidable p] {s : S3} :
269	    KRel (Guarded p s) L.arenas (kg L p s) := by
270	  unfold kg
271	  split
272	  · next h => exact ⟨.ok h, rfl⟩
273	  · next h => exact .reject h
274	
275	/-- **Step soundness** (§58, §60–§78): the computed outcome of `o` from `L` is an outcome of the
276	relation of `o`, `ok`, `reject` and `fail` alike. -/
277	theorem lstep_sound (L : LState) (o : Op) : OpRel k L o (lstep k L o) := by
278	  cases o with
279	  | derive => exact kg_sound
280	  | split => exact kg_sound
281	  | release => exact kg_sound
282	  | transfer => exact kg_sound
283	  | depend => exact kg_sound
284	  | enter => exact kg_sound
285	  | exit => exact kg_sound
286	  | read => exact kg_sound
287	  | write => exact kg_sound
288	  | writeShared => exact kg_sound
289	  | pin => exact kg_sound
290	  | unpin => exact kg_sound
291	  | endUse => exact kg_sound
292	  | free => exact kg_sound
293	  | store => exact kg_sound
294	  | alloc pr ow ls =>
295	    show KRel (AllocStep k pr ow ls L.kern) L.arenas _
296	    dsimp only [lstep]
297	    split
298	    · next h =>
299	      split
300	      · next hs => exact ⟨.ok h hs, rfl⟩
301	      · next hs => exact .fail h hs
302	    · next h => exact .reject h
303	  | newArena st i =>
304	    show NewArenaStep [] st i L _
305	    dsimp only [lstep]
306	    split
307	    · next h => exact .ok h
308	    · next h => exact .reject h
309	  | issue i r d =>
310	    show IssueD k i r d L _
311	    dsimp only [lstep]
312	    split
313	    · next hE => exact .noEntry hE
314	    · next E hE =>
315	      split
316	      · next h1 =>
317	        split
318	        · next h2 =>
319	          split
320	          · next h3 =>
321	            split
322	            · next h4 => exact .ok hE h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.ok h4)
323	            · next h4 => exact .store hE h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.reject h4)
324	          · next h3 => exact .split hE h1 h2 (.reject h3)
325	        · next h2 => exact .fail hE h1 h2
326	      · next h1 => exact .static hE h1
327	  | reset i =>
328	    show ResetD i L _
329	    dsimp only [lstep]
330	    split
331	    · next hE => exact .noEntry hE
332	    · next E hE =>
333	      split
334	      · next h1 =>
335	        split
336	        · next h2 =>
337	          split
338	          · next h3 => exact .ok hE (.ok h1) (.ok h2) h3
339	          · next h3 => exact .contract hE (.ok h1) (.ok h2) h3
340	        · next h2 => exact .release hE (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
341	      · next h1 => exact .derive hE (.reject h1)
342	
343	/-- An `ok` computed step is a library step (Part XIV, §58). -/
344	theorem lstep_ok {L L' : LState} {o : Op} (h : lstep k L o = .ok L') : LStep k L L' :=
345	  opRel_ok (h ▸ lstep_sound L o)
346	
347	/-- A run whose steps are all `ok`, from a library-reachable state, ends in a library-reachable
348	state (Part XIV, §46). -/
349	theorem lrun_reach {statics : Statics} :
350	    ∀ {L L' : LState} {os : List Op}, LReach k statics L → lrun k L os = some L' →
351	      LReach k statics L'
352	  | _, _, [], hL, h => by cases h; exact hL
353	  | L, _, o :: os, hL, h => by
354	    unfold lrun at h
355	    cases hs : lstep k L o with
356	    | ok L₁ => rw [hs] at h; exact lrun_reach (.step hL (lstep_ok hs)) h
357	    | reject => rw [hs] at h; cases h
358	    | fail => rw [hs] at h; cases h
359	
360	/-- **Run soundness** (§47, §57, Part XIV): when every step of `os` from `LState.init statics` is
361	`ok`, the run reaches `final k statics os`, which is library-reachable and whose kernel state is
362	reachable by O1–O16. -/
363	theorem runsTo {statics : Statics} {os : List Op}
364	    (h : (lrun k (LState.init statics) os).isSome = true) : Runs k statics os := by
365	  have hr : lrun k (LState.init statics) os = some (final k statics os) := by
366	    unfold final
367	    cases e : lrun k (LState.init statics) os with
368	    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
369	    | some L => rfl
370	  have hl := lrun_reach .init hr
371	  exact ⟨hr, hl, hl.ng.reachable⟩
372	
373	/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
374	theorem rejects {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .reject) :
375	    OpRel k L o .reject := by
376	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
377	  revert hs h
378	  cases lstep k L o with
379	  | ok => intro h; cases h
380	  | reject => intro _ hs; exact hs
381	  | fail => intro h; cases h
382	
383	/-- A computed `fail` is a `fail` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
384	theorem fails {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .fail) :
385	    OpRel k L o .fail := by
386	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
387	  revert hs h
388	  cases lstep k L o with
389	  | ok => intro h; cases h
390	  | reject => intro h; cases h
391	  | fail => intro _ hs; exact hs
392	
393	/-- A computed `ok` is the `ok` outcome of the relation to `next k L o` (§58). -/
394	theorem oks {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .ok) :
395	    OpRel k L o (.ok (next k L o)) := by
396	  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
397	  unfold next
398	  revert hs h
399	  cases lstep k L o with
400	  | ok => intro _ hs; exact hs
401	  | reject => intro h; cases h
402	  | fail => intro h; cases h

8	`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` (§60–§78), plus new cases fixed by spec clauses and the
9	usage scenario W3 (material §5b). This is a test module: no model module imports it.

12	`RunsTo k statics os L` states that every step is `ok` and that `L` is library-reachable and its

14	its operation (`DeriveStep`, `TransferStep`, `IssueD`, `ResetD`, …) on the reached state and
15	decided by `decide`. Each docstring gives the expected verdict from the case's source (the
16	material, or the spec clause for new cases), the obtained verdict, the class (material §0, rule 5:
17	`N3` kernel, `Lib` library instance, `spec 3` another specification) and the positive twin (rule 2:
18	the same sequence without the faulty element, accepted). A case whose obtained verdict differs from
19	the expected one is kept with its expected verdict and marked **MISMATCH** with its cause; no case

4	/-!
5	# Handle pool: a library instance of the access discipline (non-normative)
6	
7	**Non-normative.** This module formalizes the library contract "HandlePool v0.4 annex" (items
8	D.1–D.4), which `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` does not define (§75, Part XIV
9	preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their library abstractions and
10	are not defined here"). The normative clauses that constrain it are
11	§36 (`MetaRight` is exercisable `Modify` on the administering value; `writeShared` alone is
12	insufficient), §37 and §89 (handles are data, not authorities), §38 and §46 (library state outside
13	`S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (the guard over all registries of live administrations)
14	and §58 (outcomes, statics before `fail`).
15	
16	The pool registry lives beside the kernel state (`PState`). Its operations are built on the
17	kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75): `newPool` registers only; `allocSlot` writes the handle into
18	its destination (O10); `resolve` derives a companion from `internal` over the whole storage, then
19	an entry authority from the companion (O1 twice); `resolveMany` does the same with `split` (O2) in
20	`Modify` and with one `Observe` derive per handle (O1) in `Observe`; `unresolve` releases (O3).
21	`freeSlot` applies the effect function of O12 (§69) to the slot content under preconditions that
22	exempt `internal` and its ancestors (`ContentEndPre`): it is not a kernel `endUse` step.
23	`contentEnd_preserves` proves that it preserves `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57); `pstep_kernel` states what
24	every pool step is on the kernel side.
25	-/
26

32	/-! ## Library state (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §38, §46) -/

34	/-- Slot of a pool entry (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`;

41	
42	/-- Pool entry `{storage, internal, slots}` with its logical identity (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1;

44	structure Pool where
45	  id : Nat
46	  storage : Nat
47	  internal : Nat
48	  slots : List Slot
49	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
50	
51	/-- Handle `(poolId, slot, gen)`: data, not an authority (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §37, §89;
52	non-normative library contract). -/
53	structure Handle where
54	  id : Nat
55	  slot : Nat
56	  gen : Nat
57	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
58	
59	/-- Ghost record of a resolution (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; auxiliary information creating no
60	right, §38): pool identity and `internal`, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities
61	tagged with their slot and resolved generation. Read only by `unresolve` and by the invariants. -/
62	structure Res where
63	  pool : Nat
64	  internal : Nat
65	  comp : Nat
66	  mode : Mode
67	  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
68	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
69	
70	/-- Library state (§38, §46; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library contract): the
71	kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the pool registry, the next fresh pool identity and the ghost
72	resolutions. -/
73	structure PState where
74	  kern : S3
75	  pools : List Pool
76	  nId : Nat
77	  res : List Res
78	
79	/-- Initial library state (§47; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1): the initial kernel state, an empty
80	registry. -/
81	def PState.init (statics : Statics) : PState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩
82	
83	/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse `MetaRight` of §36
84	(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library contract). -/
85	def Pool.entry (pl : Pool) : Arena.ArenaEntry := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩
86	
87	/-- Administrative right on the pool (§36; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, corrected by §36;
88	non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active) and `MetaRight` holds,
89	exercisable `Modify` over the pool value; no `writeShared` branch. -/
90	def AdminRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Prop := s.Active pl.internal ∧ Arena.MetaRight s pl.entry
91	
92	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36). -/
93	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (AdminRight s pl) := by
94	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
95	
96	/-- Place of slot `i`, `0` if absent (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library
97	contract; §46). -/
98	def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0
99	
100	/-- The pool with slot `i` replaced (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library
101	contract; §46). -/
102	def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }

104	/-! ## `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §56) -/
105	
106	/-- The pool registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1;
107	non-normative library contract): the `internal` identities of its live pools. -/
108	def liveInternals (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) : List Nat :=
109	  (pools.filter fun pl => decide (s.Active pl.internal)).map (·.internal)
110	
111	/-- Preconditions of `newPool(storage, internal)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative
112	library contract; §56, §76). -/
113	structure NewPoolPre (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat))
114	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
115	  /-- D.1: "reprend les autres obligations applicables de `newArena`" (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5). -/
116	  base : Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal
117	  /-- D.1: every leaf of the input storage is `Uninit`. -/
118	  uninit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit
119	  /-- D.1, §56: `internal` is absent from the pool registry and from every other registry of live
120	  administrations `others`. -/
121	  guard : Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal
122	
123	/-- Decidability of `NewPoolPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §56, §76). -/
124	instance (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
125	    Decidable (NewPoolPre s pools others storage internal) :=
126	  decidable_of_iff (Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
127	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit) ∧
128	    Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal)
129	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩
130	
131	/-- Effect of `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library contract): a pool with
132	the fresh identity `nId`, one free slot of generation zero per child of the storage, the kernel
133	state unchanged (§46, §76). -/
134	def newPoolEff (L : PState) (storage internal : Nat) : PState :=
135	  { L with
136	    pools := L.pools ++ [⟨L.nId, storage, internal,
137	      (kids L.kern.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
138	    nId := L.nId + 1 }
139	
140	/-- `newPool` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §58; non-normative library contract):
141	`ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of live administrations (§56). -/
142	def NewPoolStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : PState) :
143	    Outcome3 PState → Prop :=
144	  Guarded (NewPoolPre L.kern L.pools others storage internal) (newPoolEff L storage internal)
145	
146	/-! ## `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3) -/
147	
148	/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot(pool, dst)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, corrected by §36;
149	non-normative library contract). "Apte à recevoir la représentation d'un handle" names no state
150	component and is not represented. -/
151	structure AllocSlotStatic (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
152	  /-- D.3, §36: live pool and `MetaRight`. -/
153	  right : AdminRight s pl
154	  /-- D.3: `dst` is usable. -/
155	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
156	  /-- D.3: `dst` is a leaf (the handle is written into "la seule feuille `dst`"). -/
157	  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
158	  /-- D.3 with §67.1: the write of the handle needs exercisable `Modify` over `dst`. -/
159	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
160	  /-- D.3: `dst` is not `Init`. -/
161	  dstNotInit : s.I dst ≠ .init
162	  /-- D.3: `dst` holds no active authority. -/
163	  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
164	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
165	
166	/-- Decidability of `AllocSlotStatic` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §36, §67). -/
167	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (AllocSlotStatic s pl dst) :=
168	  decidable_of_iff (AdminRight s pl ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
169	    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧ ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
170	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True)
171	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩
172	
173	/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative
174	library contract): the slot becomes live with its generation kept; the handle is written into the
175	leaf `dst`, which alone becomes `Init` (§67 effect). -/
176	def allocSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PState :=
177	  { L with
178	    kern := write3Eff L.kern [dst]
179	    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) }
180	
181	/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` for slot `i` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative
182	library contract; §37, §89). -/
183	def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
184	  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩
185	
186	/-- `allocSlot(pool j, dst)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §58; non-normative library
187	contract): `reject` without the pool or a static precondition; then `fail` when no slot is free;
188	`ok` on any free slot. -/
189	inductive AllocSlotStep (j dst : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
190	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
191	  | static {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
192	      AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
193	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
194	      (∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, sl.live = true) → AllocSlotStep j dst L .fail
195	  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
196	      pl.slots[i]? = some sl → sl.live = false →
197	      AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok (allocSlotEff L j pl i sl dst))
198	
199	/-! ## `resolve`, `resolveMany` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2) -/
200	
201	/-- The handle designates a live slot of the pool at its generation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2,
202	D.3; §89; non-normative library contract); a slot index outside the pool designates nothing. -/
203	def HandleOK (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
204	  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False
205	
206	/-- Decidability of `HandleOK` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §89). -/
207	instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK pl h) := by
208	  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance
209	
210	/-- Legal exercise of `internal` at mode `m` for the companion (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2;
211	non-normative library contract): the preconditions of the `derive` of the companion from
212	`internal` over all leaves of the storage (§60). -/
213	def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
214	  DerivePre s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
215	
216	/-- Decidability of `ResolveRight` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60). -/
217	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
218	  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance
219	
220	/-- State after the companion (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60 effect; non-normative library
221	contract): authority `|A|`, derived from `internal` at mode `m` over all leaves of the storage. -/
222	def compS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
223	  deriveEff s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
224	
225	/-- Observe derivations from `c`, one per region in order (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2:
226	`resolveMany` in `Observe`; §60; non-normative library contract): each accepted in the state left
227	by the previous ones. -/
228	def DerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → Prop
229	  | [] => True
230	  | r :: rs => DerivePre s c r .observe ∧ DerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
231	
232	/-- Decidability of `DerivesPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2, §60). -/
233	instance decDerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) :
234	    (rs : List (List Nat)) → Decidable (DerivesPre s c rs)
235	  | [] => isTrue trivial
236	  | r :: rs =>
237	    have := decDerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
238	    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
239	
240	/-- Effect of the `Observe` derivations from `c`, in order (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60 effect).
241	-/
242	def derivesEff (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → S3
243	  | [] => s
244	  | r :: rs => derivesEff (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
245	
246	/-- Entry authorities of a batch from the companion `c` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative
247	library contract): `split` (§61) in `Modify`, successive `Observe` derivations (§60) in
248	`Observe`. -/
249	def EntriesPre (k : K) : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → Prop
250	  | .modify, s, c, rs => SplitPre k s c rs
251	  | .observe, s, c, rs => DerivesPre s c rs
252	
253	/-- Decidability of `EntriesPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60, §61). -/
254	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (m : Mode) (s : S3) (c : Nat)
255	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (EntriesPre k m s c rs) := by
256	  cases m <;> unfold EntriesPre <;> infer_instance
257	
258	/-- Effect of the entry authorities of a batch (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60, §61 effects). -/
259	def entriesEff : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → S3
260	  | .modify, s, c, rs => splitEff s c rs
261	  | .observe, s, c, rs => derivesEff s c rs
262	
263	/-- Regions of the entries designated by a batch: the footprint of each slot (HandlePool v0.4
264	annex, D.2; non-normative library contract; §60). -/
265	def entryRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
266	  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)
267	
268	/-- Ghost entries of a batch: the `n`-th entry authority is `c + 1 + n`, for slot and generation of
269	the `n`-th handle (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; auxiliary, §38). -/
270	def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
271	  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs
272	
273	/-- `resolve(h, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative
274	library contract): `reject` without the pool or the legal exercise of `internal`; then `fail` for
275	a handle of another pool, stale, absent or free; then the companion and the entry authority
276	derived from it, `reject` when the second derivation is not accepted. -/
277	inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
278	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
279	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
280	      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
281	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
282	      ResolveStep j h m L .fail
283	  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
284	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
285	      ¬ DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
286	      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
287	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
288	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
289	      DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
290	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok { L with
291	        kern := deriveEff (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m
292	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
293	          [(L.kern.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
294	
295	/-- Validity of a batch (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative library contract): every handle
296	designates a live slot at its generation; pairwise distinct slots in `Modify` only (§58, §89). -/
297	def BatchOK (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
298	  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK pl h) ∧ (m = .modify → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup)
299	
300	/-- Decidability of `BatchOK` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58, §89). -/
301	instance (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Decidable (BatchOK pl hs m) := by
302	  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance
303	
304	/-- `resolveMany(hs, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative
305	library contract): `reject` without the pool or the legal exercise of `internal`; then an atomic
306	`fail` for an invalid batch; then one companion and the entry authorities (`EntriesPre`), `reject`
307	when they are not accepted. -/
308	inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) :
309	    Outcome3 PState → Prop where
310	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
311	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
312	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
313	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ¬ BatchOK pl hs m →
314	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .fail
315	  | noEntries {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → BatchOK pl hs m →
316	      ¬ EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
317	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
318	  | ok {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → BatchOK pl hs m →
319	      EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
320	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok { L with
321	        kern := entriesEff m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs)
322	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
323	          batchEntries L.kern.A.length hs⟩] })
324	
325	/-! ## `unresolve` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2) -/
326	
327	/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (§62); `none` as soon as one release is not
328	accepted (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2: "Les règles de `release` … restent applicables"). -/
329	def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
330	  | s, [] => some s
331	  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none
332	
333	/-- The resolution of companion `c` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; ghost lookup, §38). -/
334	def findRes (L : PState) (c : Nat) : Option Res := L.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c
335	
336	/-- Authorities released by `unresolve` of `r` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative library
337	contract): the entry authorities still active, then the companion (§62). -/
338	def unresolveList (s : S3) (r : Res) : List Nat :=
339	  ((r.entries.map (·.1)).filter fun a => decide (s.Active a)) ++ [r.comp]
340	
341	/-- `unresolve(c)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative library
342	contract): the releases of `unresolveList`; `reject` when one is not accepted or `c` is no
343	companion. -/
344	inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
345	  | none : findRes L c = none → UnresolveStep c L .reject
346	  | reject {r : Res} : findRes L c = some r → releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = none →
347	      UnresolveStep c L .reject
348	  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes L c = some r →
349	      releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = some s' →
350	      UnresolveStep c L (.ok { L with kern := s' })
351	
352	/-! ## `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3) -/
353	
354	/-- `x` is exempt from the end-of-use checks of a slot of the pool of `internal` `i`: `internal` or
355	one of its ancestors (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "hors `internal` et ses ancêtres"; non-normative
356	library contract; §69). -/
357	def Exempt (s : S3) (i x : Nat) : Prop := x = i ∨ x ∈ s.ancs i
358	
359	/-- Decidability of `Exempt` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §69). -/
360	instance (s : S3) (i x : Nat) : Decidable (Exempt s i x) := by unfold Exempt; infer_instance
361	
362	/-- §69.2 for storage that dies with the content (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: the end-of-use
363	effects of O12; non-normative library contract): an active derived authority over a leaf of a place
364	that stops being usable is held within the slot `q` or by a dying holder. -/
365	def DyingAccessOK (s : S3) (q j : Nat) : Prop :=
366	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
367	    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s q).Usable l) →
368	      heldIn s.P q y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s q) y.holder) True
369	
370	/-- Decidability of `DyingAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
371	instance (s : S3) (q j : Nat) : Decidable (DyingAccessOK s q j) := by
372	  unfold DyingAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
373	
374	/-- §69.3 with the exemption of D.3 (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library contract):
375	anchor `x` of a place remaining usable is not held within the slot `q` and keeps a live holder;
376	unless exempt, it is not a root of `q`. -/
377	def ContentAnchorOK (s : S3) (q i x : Nat) : Prop :=
378	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P q y.holder ∧ (¬ Exempt s i x → ¬ IsRootOf s q y) ∧
379	    HolderLive (endUseS s q) y.holder) True
380	
381	/-- Decidability of `ContentAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
382	instance (s : S3) (q i x : Nat) : Decidable (ContentAnchorOK s q i x) := by
383	  unfold ContentAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
384	
385	/-- Preconditions of the end of the content of slot place `q` of the pool of `internal` `i`
386	(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "la fin logique du contenu doit être admissible"; the preconditions
387	of O12, §69, excluding `internal` and its ancestors; non-normative library contract). §69.1 is not
388	a precondition: `freeSlot_modify_right` derives it from `AdminRight`. -/
389	structure ContentEndPre (k : K) (s : S3) (q i : Nat) : Prop where
390	  /-- D.3: no active authority covers the entry except `internal` and its ancestors (§69.2 on the
391	  leaves of the entry, with the exemption). -/
392	  entry : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j → (∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q) →
393	    Exempt s i j
394	  /-- §69.2 on the storage that dies with the content. -/
395	  dying : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, DyingAccessOK s q j
396	  /-- D.3, §69.3: no usable dependency is invalidated. -/
397	  anchors : ∀ q' ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s q).Usable q' →
398	    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s q).D q', ContentAnchorOK s q i x
399	  /-- D.3, §69.4: no ending leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
400	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s q l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
401	
402	/-- Decidability of `ContentEndPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §69). -/
403	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (q i : Nat) :
404	    Decidable (ContentEndPre k s q i) :=
405	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j →
406	      (∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q) → Exempt s i j) ∧
407	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, DyingAccessOK s q j) ∧
408	    (∀ q' ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s q).Usable q' →
409	      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s q).D q', ContentAnchorOK s q i x) ∧
410	    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s q l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
411	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩
412	
413	/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library
414	contract): the effects of O12 on the slot content (`endUseEff`, §69), no deallocation; the slot
415	becomes free and its generation is incremented. -/
416	def freeSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PState :=
417	  { L with
418	    kern := endUseEff L.kern sl.place
419	    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) }
420	
421	/-- `freeSlot(h)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, corrected by §36; §58;
422	non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool, without a live pool or `MetaRight`;
423	then `fail` for a handle of another pool, stale, absent or free; then `reject` unless the end of
424	the content is admissible (`ContentEndPre`). -/
425	inductive FreeSlotStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
426	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep k j h L .reject
427	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AdminRight L.kern pl →
428	      FreeSlotStep k j h L .reject
429	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
430	      FreeSlotStep k j h L .fail
431	  | noEnd {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl →
432	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ ContentEndPre k L.kern sl.place pl.internal →
433	      FreeSlotStep k j h L .reject
434	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl →
435	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ContentEndPre k L.kern sl.place pl.internal →
436	      FreeSlotStep k j h L (.ok (freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl))
437	
438	/-! ## Library runs (HandlePool v0.4 annex; §38, §46, §57) -/
439	
440	/-- One `ok` step of a library run (HandlePool v0.4 annex; non-normative library contract): a
441	kernel step O1–O16 of non-administrative code, the registry unchanged, or an accepted pool
442	operation (§57, §58). -/
443	inductive PStep (k : K) : PState → PState → Prop where
444	  | kernel {L : PState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → PStep k L { L with kern := s' }
445	  | newPool {L L' : PState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
446	      NewPoolStep others st i L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
447	  | allocSlot {L L' : PState} {j dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
448	  | resolve {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} :
449	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
450	  | resolveMany {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :

1865	      have hna : ¬ a < L.pools.length := fun hl => by
1866	        rw [show (newPoolEff L st i).pools = L.pools ++ _ from rfl,
1867	          List.getElem?_append_left hl] at ha
1868	        exact hg pa (List.mem_of_getElem? ha) haa (ea ▸ rfl)
1869	      have hnb : ¬ b < L.pools.length := fun hl => by
1870	        rw [show (newPoolEff L st i).pools = L.pools ++ _ from rfl,
1871	          List.getElem?_append_left hl] at hb
1872	        exact hg pb (List.mem_of_getElem? hb) hba (eb ▸ rfl)
1873	      omega
1874	  · rcases List.mem_append.1 hpl with hpl | hpl
1875	    · exact hr pl hpl
1876	    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hpl]; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
1877	
1878	/-- `live_pool_internal_unique` (§56; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1): on every library-reachable
1879	state, two live pools at distinct positions of the registry have distinct `internal`. The guard of
1880	`newPool` gives it; no kernel invariant is needed. -/
1881	theorem live_pool_internal_unique {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState}
1882	    (h : PReach k statics L) : Unique56 L ∧ RegOK L := by
1883	  induction h with
1884	  | init => exact ⟨fun _ _ _ _ _ ha => by simp [PState.init] at ha, fun _ h => by
1885	      simp [PState.init] at h⟩
1886	  | step _ hs ih =>
1887	    obtain ⟨hu, hr⟩ := ih
1888	    cases hs with
1889	    | kernel hk => exact unique56_keep hu hr (Arena.kstep_akeep hk) fun _ => rfl
1890	    | allocSlot hs =>
1891	      cases hs with
1892	      | ok hj _ _ _ => exact unique56_keep hu hr (Arena.akeep_of_eq rfl) (internals_set hj)
1893	    | resolve hs =>
1894	      cases hs with
1895	      | ok =>
1896	        exact unique56_keep hu hr (Arena.akeep_append (resolve_A _ _ _ _)) fun _ => rfl
1897	    | resolveMany hs =>
1898	      cases hs with
1899	      | ok => exact unique56_keep hu hr (Arena.akeep_append (resolveMany_A _ _ _ _)) fun _ => rfl
1900	    | unresolve hs =>
1901	      cases hs with
1902	      | ok _ hrl => exact unique56_keep hu hr (releaseAll_kseq (k := k) hrl).keep.1 fun _ => rfl
1903	    | freeSlot hs =>
1904	      cases hs with
1905	      | ok hj _ _ _ _ => exact unique56_keep hu hr (endUseEff_akeep _ _) (internals_set hj)
1906	    | newPool hs => exact unique56_newPool hu hr hs
1907	
1908	/-! ## Witnesses on library-reachable states (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2, D.3)
1909	
1910	Runs from `PState.init Witness.hst` under the test contract `Examples.K0` (§48). Statics (§47):
1911	place 0 is the pool storage, with two leaf children 1 and 2 (`Uninit`); place 3 is the pool value
1912	(`Init`); place 4 is a destination (`Uninit`); root authorities 0, 1 and 2 cover places 0, 3 and 4.
1913	`internal` is authority 3, derived from 0 over `[1, 2]` and stored in place 3. Every precondition is
1914	decided by `decide`. -/
1915	
1916	namespace Witness
1917	
1918	open Examples
1919	
1920	/-- Statics of the witnesses (§47; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1). -/
1921	def hst : Statics :=
1922	  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false),
1923	    ((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false)]
1924	
1925	/-- Initial library state (§47). -/
1926	def w0 : PState := PState.init hst
1927	
1928	/-- After `derive(0, [1, 2], Modify)` (§60): authority 3, the future `internal`. -/
1929	def w1 : PState := { w0 with kern := deriveEff w0.kern 0 [1, 2] .modify }
1930	
1931	/-- After `store(3, 3)` (§65): `internal` is held by the pool value, place 3. -/
1932	def w2 : PState := { w1 with kern := storeEff w1.kern 3 3 }
1933	
1934	/-- After `newPool(0, 3)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1): pool 0 with slots 1 and 2, free, of
1935	generation 0 (§47). -/
1936	def w3 : PState := newPoolEff w2 0 3
1937	
1938	/-- Pool 0 after `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §47). -/
1939	def pl3 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 3, [⟨1, 0, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
1940	
1941	/-- After `allocSlot(0, 4)` on slot 0 (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3): the handle `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is
1942	written into place 4 (§47, §67). -/
1943	def w4 : PState := allocSlotEff w3 0 pl3 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 4
1944	
1945	/-- Pool 0 after `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §47). -/
1946	def pl4 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 3, [⟨1, 0, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
1947	
1948	/-- `w3` is reached by a library run whose steps start from states satisfying `KInv` (§57, §60,
1949	§65; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1). -/
1950	theorem w3_reach : PReachI K0 hst w3 :=
1951	  .step (.step (.step .init (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
1952	    (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
1953	    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
1954	    (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
1955	
1956	/-- `w4` is library-reachable (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §47, §67). -/
1957	theorem w4_reach : PReachI K0 hst w4 :=
1958	  .step w3_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
1959	    (.allocSlot (.ok (pl := pl3) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl))
1960	
1961	/-- `resolveMany` in `Observe` accepts a repeated valid handle (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2: "la
1962	répétition du même handle valide est permise"): two `Observe` entry authorities on slot 0, derived
1963	from one `Observe` companion; the same batch in `Modify` fails (§60). -/
1964	theorem observe_repeat_ok :
1965	    (∃ L', ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .observe w4 (.ok L') ∧ PReachI K0 hst L' ∧
1966	      L'.res = [⟨0, 3, 4, .observe, [(5, 0, 0), (6, 0, 0)]⟩]) ∧
1967	    ∀ o, ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .modify w4 o → o = .fail := by
1968	  have hok : ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .observe w4 (.ok _) :=
1969	    .ok (pl := pl4) rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
1970	  exact ⟨⟨_, hok, .step w4_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 (.resolveMany hok), rfl⟩,
1971	    (pool_resolveMany_distinct (L' := w4) (pl := pl4)).1 rfl (by decide) (by decide)⟩
1972	
1973	/-- `freeSlot` is not a kernel `endUse` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "Le contrôle n'interprète pas
1974	`internal` comme un emprunt externe"; §69.2): on `w4`, `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` is accepted, while the
1975	kernel `endUse` of slot place 1 is rejected, because `internal` (authority 3, derived, active,
1976	covering place 1) is held by the pool value outside the slot. Both states satisfy `KInv ∧ KAux`
1977	(§57), decided through `Arena.KInvB`. -/
1978	theorem freeSlot_not_endUse :
1979	    (∃ L', FreeSlotStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ w4 (.ok L') ∧ PReachI K0 hst L' ∧
1980	      KInv L'.kern ∧ KAux L'.kern) ∧
1981	      ¬ EndUsePre K0 w4.kern 1 ∧ KInv w4.kern ∧ KAux w4.kern := by
1982	  have hok : FreeSlotStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ w4 (.ok _) :=
1983	    .ok (pl := pl4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
1984	  have hk4 : KInv w4.kern ∧ KAux w4.kern := Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)
1985	  exact ⟨⟨_, hok, .step w4_reach hk4.1 (.freeSlot hok), Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)⟩, by decide,
1986	    hk4⟩
1987	
1988	/-- Contract problem (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "Le contenu du slot demeure `Uninit` jusqu'à son
1989	écriture ; l'écriture du handle dans `dst` n'initialise pas le slot"): the preconditions of
1990	`allocSlot` do not exclude a destination inside the allocated slot. On `w3`, `allocSlot(0, 1)` is
1991	accepted on slot 0, whose place is 1: the slot becomes live and its content `Init` (§67). -/
1992	theorem allocSlot_into_own_slot :
1993	    ∃ L', AllocSlotStep 0 1 w3 (.ok L') ∧ PReachI K0 hst L' ∧
1994	      L'.pools[0]? = some pl4 ∧ L'.kern.I 1 = .init := by
1995	  have hok : AllocSlotStep 0 1 w3 (.ok (allocSlotEff w3 0 pl3 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 1)) :=
1996	    .ok rfl (by decide) rfl rfl
1997	  exact ⟨_, hok, .step w3_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 (.allocSlot hok), rfl, by decide⟩
1998	
1999	/-- Contract problem (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1: "Les entrées libres sont `Uninit`"): free
2000	entries are not `Uninit` in every library-reachable state. On `w3`, a frame with `Modify` over the
2001	pool value derives from `internal` over slot place 1 (O1, §60) and writes it (O10, §67): slot 0
2002	stays free while its content is `Init`. -/
2003	theorem free_slot_init :
2004	    ∃ L, PReachI K0 hst L ∧ L.pools[0]? = some pl3 ∧ L.kern.I 1 = .init := by
2005	  have h₁ : PStep K0 w3 { w3 with kern := deriveEff w3.kern 3 [1] .modify } :=
2006	    .kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
2007	  have h₂ : PStep K0 { w3 with kern := deriveEff w3.kern 3 [1] .modify }
2008	      { w3 with kern := write3Eff (deriveEff w3.kern 3 [1] .modify) [1] } :=
2009	    .kernel (.write (a := 4) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
2010	  exact ⟨_, .step (.step w3_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 h₁)
2011	    (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 h₂, rfl, by decide⟩
2012	
2013	end Witness
2014	
2015	end Ern.Lib.HandlePool
