4	/-!
5	# DataStack: a library administrative abstraction (contract DS-v1, non-normative)
6	
7	A `DataStack` instance of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`. The spec does not define
8	its contract (Part XIV preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their
9	library abstractions and are not defined here"). The contract formalized here is the library
10	contract **DS-v1**, which is **not normative**: every definition below that encodes a DS-v1 item
11	says so. The normative clauses that constrain it are §36 (`MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable
12	on the stack value; the abstraction adds no rights to the kernel), §38 and §46 (library state
13	separate from `S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (guard over all registries of live
14	administrations) and §58 (outcomes).
15	
16	DS-v1: marks carry the stack identity and a fresh mark identifier; the stack keeps the ordered list
17	of live marks; `rewind m` fails on a dead or foreign mark, rejects if an active authority derived
18	from `internal` covers a cell above `m`, otherwise returns those cells to available and removes `m`
19	and every mark above it; `push` and `grow` use the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`: its
20	static checks, the availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` and `store` of the block); `grow`
21	is in place only (same base, extension into the space directly after the block, `fail` otherwise).
22	
23	Every `ok` step of the library is a sequence of kernel steps O1–O16 (`DReach.reachable`), so the
24	abstraction adds no rights to the kernel (§36).
25	-/
26	
27	namespace Ern.Lib.DataStack
28	
29	open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
30	
31	/-! ## Library state (DS-v1; §38, §46, §47) -/
32	
33	/-- A block issued by a stack (DS-v1, non-normative; recorded like the issuances of §46): position
34	`base` of its first cell and number `size` of cells among the ordered cells of the stack, block
35	authority `auth`, destination `dst` that received it. -/
36	structure Blk where
37	  base : Nat
38	  size : Nat
39	  auth : Nat
40	  dst : Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- A mark (DS-v1, non-normative: "marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark identifier";
44	library metadata of an administrative abstraction, §36, §38): the identity of its stack, its fresh
45	identifier, the top of the stack when it was taken. -/
46	structure Mark where
47	  stack : Nat
48	  id : Nat
49	  top : Nat
50	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
51	
52	/-- A stack (DS-v1, non-normative; library state, §38, §46): administered storage, `internal`
53	authority held by the stack value (§36), ordered cells (the leaves of the storage at creation),
54	top (the cells at positions `≥ top` are available), issued blocks (oldest first), and the ordered
55	list of live marks (DS-v1: "the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks"). -/
56	structure Stack where
57	  storage : Nat
58	  internal : Nat
59	  cells : List Nat
60	  top : Nat
61	  blocks : List Blk
62	  marks : List Mark
63	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
64	
65	/-- State of the stack library (DS-v1, non-normative; §38: administrative states of library
66	abstractions are separate from `S₃`): the kernel state, the stack registry (a stack is identified
67	by its index; stacks are never removed) and the next fresh mark identifier. -/
68	structure DState where
69	  kern : S3
70	  stacks : List Stack
71	  fresh : Nat
72	
73	/-- Initial state (§47: the kernel's initial state; the library registry starts empty; DS-v1,
74	non-normative: no mark identifier given out). -/
75	def DState.init (statics : Statics) : DState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0⟩
76	
77	/-- The `n` cells from position `b` of the stack, leaves of the administered storage (§46; DS-v1,
78	non-normative). -/
79	def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n
80	
81	/-- The cells above mark `m` (DS-v1, non-normative, "a cell above m"; reading recorded; §46
82	available leaves): the positions from the top of `m` to the current top, those that `rewind m`
83	returns to available. -/
84	def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)
85	
86	/-- The stack seen as an administration entry (§46, §36; DS-v1, non-normative): storage,
87	`internal`, available cells (positions `≥ top`) and issued blocks. Used for `MetaRight` and the
88	static checks of the derived `issue`, which read only the storage and `internal`. -/
89	def Stack.entry (st : Stack) : ArenaEntry :=
90	  ⟨st.storage, st.internal, st.cells.drop st.top,
91	    st.blocks.map fun x => (cellsOf st x.base x.size, x.auth)⟩
92	
93	/-- The block of the stack whose authority is `b` (§46 issuances; DS-v1, non-normative). -/
94	def Stack.block (st : Stack) (b : Nat) : Option Blk := st.blocks.find? fun y => decide (y.auth = b)
95	
96	/-- A live mark of stack `j` (DS-v1, non-normative: a mark that is neither dead nor foreign; it
97	decides the `fail` case of `rewind`, §58): it names stack `j` and belongs to its list of live
98	marks. -/
99	def LiveMark (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop := m.stack = j ∧ m ∈ st.marks
100	
101	/-- Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v1). -/
102	instance (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Decidable (LiveMark j st m) := by
103	  unfold LiveMark; infer_instance
104	
105	/-- The administrative right of §36 for a stack (DS-v1, non-normative, with §36 and §46 read for a
106	stack): the stack is live (`internal` is active) and `MetaRight`, `Modify` exercisable on the stack
107	value, the place holding `internal`. -/
108	def AdminRight (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Prop := s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRight s st.entry
109	
110	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v1). -/
111	instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Decidable (AdminRight s st) := by
112	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
113	
114	/-! ## `newStack` and the guard of §56 -/
115	
116	/-- The stack registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; DS-v1, non-normative): the
117	`internal` identities of its live stacks. -/
118	def stackInternals (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) : List Nat :=
119	  (stacks.filter fun st => decide (s.Active st.internal)).map (·.internal)
120	
121	/-- Preconditions of `newStack(storage, internal)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §56): those of `newArena`
122	other than its guard (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3 and §76.5 read for a stack), and the guard of §56
123	over the stack registry and every other registry of live administrations `others`. -/
124	structure NewStackPre (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat))
125	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
126	  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, read for a stack (DS-v1). -/
127	  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
128	  /-- §56: no live administration of any registry uses `internal`. -/
129	  guard : Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal
130	
131	/-- Decidability of `NewStackPre` (§56; DS-v1). -/
132	instance (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
133	    Decidable (NewStackPre s stacks others storage internal) :=
134	  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
135	    Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal)
136	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
137	
138	/-- Effect of `newStack` (DS-v1, non-normative; §36: registration adds no rights): a stack whose
139	cells are the leaves of the storage, top 0, no block, no mark; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
140	def newStackEff (D : DState) (storage internal : Nat) : DState :=
141	  { D with stacks := D.stacks ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint D.kern.P storage, 0, [], []⟩] }
142	
143	/-- `newStack` as a relation (DS-v1, non-normative; §56, §58): `ok` or `reject`. -/
144	def NewStackStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (D : DState) :
145	    Outcome3 DState → Prop :=
146	  Guarded (NewStackPre D.kern D.stacks others storage internal) (newStackEff D storage internal)
147	
148	/-! ## `push` (DS-v1: the derived `issue`, Part XIV, §77) -/
149	
150	/-- Metadata after `push` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
151	cells leave the available part (the top rises by `size`), the block is recorded. -/
152	def pushMeta (st : Stack) (size a dst : Nat) : Stack :=
153	  { st with top := st.top + size, blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, a, dst⟩] }
154	
155	/-- `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v1, non-normative: "push uses the derived issue"): the derived `issue`
156	of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`, on the stack seen as an
157	entry: its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2, with `MetaRight` of §36), then `fail`, the
158	state unchanged, when fewer than `size` cells are left (availability, §77.4; reading recorded),
159	then `split` of `internal` on the cells (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into
160	`dst` (O8). -/
161	inductive PushStep (k : K) (j size dst : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
162	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
163	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
164	      ¬ IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
165	  | fail {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
166	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
167	      ¬ st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length → PushStep k j size dst D .fail
168	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
169	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
170	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
171	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern .reject →
172	      PushStep k j size dst D .reject
173	  | store {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
174	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
175	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
176	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
177	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
178	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
179	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
180	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
181	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
182	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
183	      PushStep k j size dst D
184	        (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩)
185	
186	/-! ## `mark` (DS-v1) -/
187	
188	/-- Metadata after `mark` (DS-v1, non-normative; library metadata, §36, §38): a mark naming stack
189	`j`, with the fresh identifier `fresh` and the current top, is appended to the live marks. -/
190	def markMeta (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (fresh : Nat) : Stack :=
191	  { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, fresh, st.top⟩] }
192	
193	/-- `mark(j)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 outcomes; §36: metadata only, no right created): `ok`
194	on an existing stack; the identifier is fresh. -/
195	inductive MarkStep (j : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
196	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → MarkStep j D .reject
197	  | ok {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
198	      MarkStep j D (.ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩)
199	
200	/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v1) -/
201	
202	/-- Metadata after `rewind m` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §78 on §46 metadata):
203	the cells above `m` return to available (the top returns to the top of `m`), the blocks from that
204	top are forgotten, `m` and every later mark are removed. -/
205	def rewindMeta (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Stack :=
206	  { st with
207	    top := m.top
208	    blocks := st.blocks.filter fun x => decide (x.base < m.top)
209	    marks := st.marks.takeWhile fun x => decide (x ≠ m) }
210	
211	/-- `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v1, non-normative): `fail`, the state unchanged, on a dead or foreign mark;
212	`reject` without the administrative right of §36; then the derived `reset` of Part XIV on the cells
213	above `m` (reading recorded): `split` of `internal` on them (O2), which rejects when an active
214	authority derived from `internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`), and `release`
215	of the derived authority (O3); `ok`: the cells return to available, `m` and the later marks are
216	removed. -/
217	inductive RewindStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
218	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → RewindStep k j m D .reject
219	  | dead {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ LiveMark j st m → RewindStep k j m D .fail
220	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → ¬ AdminRight D.kern st →
221	      RewindStep k j m D .reject
222	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → AdminRight D.kern st →
223	      SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
224	  | release {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
225	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
226	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
227	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
228	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
229	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
230	      RewindStep k j m D (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩)
231	
232	/-! ## `grow` (DS-v1: in place, the derived `issue`) -/
233	
234	/-- In-place extension (DS-v1, non-normative: "extension into the space directly after the
235	block"; the availability check of the derived `issue`, §77.4): the block ends at the top, and
236	`extra` available cells follow it. -/
237	def InPlace (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Prop :=
238	  x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ st.top + extra ≤ st.cells.length
239	
240	/-- Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v1). -/
241	instance (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Decidable (InPlace st x extra) := by
242	  unfold InPlace; infer_instance
243	
244	/-- The grown block (DS-v1, non-normative: same base, `extra` more cells, new authority `a`, same
245	destination; an issuance of §46). -/
246	def growBlk (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Blk := ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, a, x.dst⟩
247	
248	/-- Metadata after `grow` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
249	top rises by `extra`; the block is replaced by the grown block. -/
250	def growMeta (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Stack :=
251	  { st with
252	    top := st.top + extra
253	    blocks := st.blocks.map fun y => if y.auth = x.auth then growBlk x extra a else y }
254	
255	/-- `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v1, non-normative: in place only, using the derived `issue`): `reject`
256	when `b` is not a block of the stack or `extra` is zero (reading recorded); `release` of `b` (O3);
257	then the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the region of the same base and of size
258	`size + extra` into the recorded destination, on the released state: its static checks
259	(`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2), `fail`, the state unchanged, unless the extension is in place
260	(DS-v1 "fail otherwise", availability §77.4), `split` of `internal` (O2) and `store` of the new
261	block (O8). -/
262	inductive GrowStep (k : K) (j b extra : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
263	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
264	  | noBlock {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = none →
265	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
266	  | noExtra {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → extra = 0 →
267	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
268	  | release {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → 0 < extra →
269	      ReleaseStep b D.kern .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
270	  | static {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
271	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
272	      ¬ IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
273	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
274	  | fail {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
275	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
276	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
277	      ¬ InPlace st x extra → GrowStep k j b extra D .fail
278	  | split {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
279	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
280	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
281	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ .reject →
282	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
283	  | store {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
284	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
285	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
286	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
287	      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
288	  | ok {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
289	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
290	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
291	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
292	      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ (.ok s₃) →
293	      GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok ⟨s₃, D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra s₁.A.length), D.fresh⟩)
294	
295	/-! ## Library runs (DS-v1; §36, §56, §57) -/
296	
297	/-- One `ok` step of the stack library (DS-v1, non-normative): a kernel step O1–O16 of
298	non-administrative code, the registry unchanged; `newStack` with the guard of §56 against the other
299	registries `others`; `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`. -/
300	inductive DStep (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
301	  | kernel {D : DState} {s' : S3} : KStep k D.kern s' → DStep k D ⟨s', D.stacks, D.fresh⟩
302	  | newStack {D D' : DState} {others : List (List Nat)} {storage i : Nat} :
303	      NewStackStep others storage i D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
304	  | push {D D' : DState} {j size dst : Nat} : PushStep k j size dst D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
305	  | mark {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} : MarkStep j D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
306	  | rewind {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
307	  | grow {D D' : DState} {j b extra : Nat} : GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
308	
309	/-- States reachable from the initial state by library steps (DS-v1, non-normative; §47). -/
310	inductive DReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : DState → Prop where
311	  | init : DReach k statics (DState.init statics)
312	  | step {D D' : DState} : DReach k statics D → DStep k D D' → DReach k statics D'
313	
314	/-- Finite sequences of library steps (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 `ok` transitions). -/
315	inductive DRun (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
316	  | refl (D : DState) : DRun k D D
317	  | tail {D D' D'' : DState} : DRun k D D' → DStep k D' D'' → DRun k D D''
318	
319	/-- The kernel part of a library step is reached by kernel steps (§36: the abstraction adds no
320	rights to the kernel; Part XIV: `issue` is `split` then `store`, the reset part of `rewind` is
321	`split` then `release`; DS-v1). -/
322	theorem DStep.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D D' : DState}
323	    (hr : Reachable k statics D.kern) (h : DStep k D D') : Reachable k statics D'.kern := by
324	  cases h with
325	  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
326	  | newStack hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hr
327	  | push hs =>
328	    cases hs with
329	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
330	  | mark hs => cases hs with | ok _ => exact hr
331	  | rewind hs =>
332	    cases hs with
333	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.release hrl)
334	  | grow hs =>
335	    cases hs with
336	    | ok _ _ _ hrl _ _ hsp hst =>
337	      exact .step (.step (.step hr (.release hrl)) (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
338	
339	/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (§36, §57; DS-v1). -/
340	theorem DReach.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
341	    Reachable k statics D.kern := by
342	  induction h with
343	  | init => exact .init
344	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih
345	
346	/-! ## Helper lemmas (lists, kernel effects) -/
347	
348	/-- Reading a list after `set` (support for the §46 metadata updates of DS-v1). -/
349	theorem getElem?_set_cases {α : Type} {l : List α} {j i : Nat} {v x : α}
350	    (h : (l.set j v)[i]? = some x) : (i = j ∧ x = v) ∨ (i ≠ j ∧ l[i]? = some x) := by

3	/-!
4	# Arenas: the reference library abstraction (Part XIV)
5	
6	Arenas of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`, Part XIV (§76–§78), with §36, §46, §55,
7	§56, §58, §79, §86 and §88. An arena is a library abstraction (Part XIV): its entries live in a
8	library state separate from the kernel state `S₃` (§38, §46). `newArena` (O17) only registers an
9	entry; `issue` (O18) and `reset` (O19) are defined twice:
10	
11	* as their contracts, clause by clause (§77, §78): `IssueC`, `ResetC`;
12	* as derived operations over the kernel steps (Part XIV): `issue` is its static checks, the
13	  availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` on the region and `store` of the block into the
14	  destination (`IssueD`); `reset` is `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the whole storage,
15	  then `release`, then the explicit check of §78.3 (`ResetD`).
16	
17	`issue_as_kernel` and `reset_as_kernel` show that both definitions have the same outcomes and the
18	same arrival states. Library reachability (`LReach`, `LReachNG`) uses the derived operations, so
19	its kernel states are kernel-reachable (`newArena_as_library`).
20	-/
21	
22	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
23	
24	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
25	
26	/-! ## Library state (§46) -/
27	
28	/-- Arena entry (§46): administered storage, `internal` authority, available leaves and issued
29	regions with their block authorities. The sets of §46 are lists read by membership. -/
30	structure ArenaEntry where
31	  storage : Nat
32	  internal : Nat
33	  available : List Nat
34	  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
35	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
36	
37	/-- Library state (§46, §38): the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena registry. -/
38	structure LState where
39	  kern : S3
40	  arenas : List ArenaEntry
41	
42	/-- Initial library state (§47): the initial kernel state and an empty arena registry. -/
43	def LState.init (statics : Statics) : LState := ⟨S3.init statics, []⟩
44	
45	/-- Live arena (§46): `internal` is active. -/
46	def Live (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := s.Active E.internal
47	
48	/-- Decidability of `Live` (§46). -/
49	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (Live s E) :=
50	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (s.Active _))
51	
52	/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
53	def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
54	  match s.A[E.internal]? with
55	  | some y => match y.holder with
56	    | .place v => some v
57	    | .frame _ => none
58	  | none => none
59	
60	/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
61	no `writeShared` branch. -/
62	def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
63	  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False
64	
65	/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
66	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
67	  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance
68	
69	/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
70	available. -/
71	def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available
72	
73	/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
74	instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
75	  unfold Avail; infer_instance
76	
77	/-! ## `ArenaInv` (§55) -/
78	
79	/-- `ArenaInv` (§55), required for live arenas. "Still-issued" is read as "with an active block
80	authority". The clause "anchor and ownership restrictions are respected" has no referent and is
81	not represented; "complying with exclusivity and validity rules" is left to the kernel
82	invariants (§57). -/
83	structure ArenaInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
84	  /-- §55, item 1: `storage` designates an existing, usable place. -/
85	  storageUsable : s.Usable E.storage
86	  /-- §55, item 1: the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`. -/
87	  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
88	  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` is active. -/
89	  active : s.Active E.internal
90	  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and is held by a place, the arena value. -/
91	  shape : OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False
92	  /-- §55, item 3: available leaves belong to the administered storage. -/
93	  availableIn : ∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
94	  /-- §55, item 3: issued regions belong to the administered storage. -/
95	  issuedIn : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
96	  /-- §55, item 4: two still-active issuances have disjoint regions. -/
97	  disjoint : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
98	    ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1
99	  /-- §55, item 4: no leaf of a still-issued region belongs to `available`. -/
100	  notAvailable : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available
101	  /-- §55, item 5: every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal`. -/
102	  derived : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2
103	
104	/-- Shape of the issued blocks (support for §55, item 5, from the `ok` effect of §77; not a clause
105	of `ArenaInv`): every issued block authority exists, has direct origin `internal`, a fresh identity
106	above it, its region as footprint and mode `Modify`. -/
107	def IssuedShape (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
108	  ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some E.internal ∧ E.internal < e.2 ∧
109	    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify
110	
111	/-- The per-entry library invariant (§55): `ArenaInv` and the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
112	def EntryInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := ArenaInv s E ∧ IssuedShape s E
113	
114	/-- The library invariant (§55, §46): every registered `internal` exists, and every live entry
115	satisfies `EntryInv`. -/
116	def LInv (L : LState) : Prop :=
117	  ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length ∧ (Live L.kern E → EntryInv L.kern E)
118	
119	/-! ## O17 `newArena` (§76) and the guard of §56 -/
120	
121	/-- All leaves of the place holding an authority are `Init` (§76.5); vacuous for a frame. -/
122	def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
123	  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
124	  | .frame _ => True
125	
126	/-- Decidability of `LeavesInit` (§76.5). -/
127	instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
128	  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance
129	
130	/-- The unified administration guard (§56, §76.4) as a contract predicate: `internal` is absent
131	from every registry of live administrations. A registry is given by the `internal` identities of
132	its live administrations; `regs` lists all relevant registries. -/
133	def Guard56 (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Prop := ∀ R ∈ regs, i ∉ R
134	
135	/-- Decidability of `Guard56` (§56). -/
136	instance (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 regs i) := by
137	  unfold Guard56; infer_instance
138	
139	/-- The arena registry as a registry of live administrations (§46, §56): the `internal`
140	identities of its live entries. -/
141	def liveInternals (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) : List Nat :=
142	  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)
143	
144	/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5).
145	§76.6 restates invariants and is not a precondition (`newArena_clause6`). -/
146	structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
147	  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
148	  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
149	  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
150	  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
151	  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
152	  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
153	  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
154	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
155	  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
156	  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
157	  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
158	  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
159	  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
160	  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
161	  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
162	  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True
163	
164	/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
165	instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
166	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
167	    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
168	    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
169	    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
170	    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
171	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
172	    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True)
173	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
174	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
175	
176	/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
177	§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
178	structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
179	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
180	  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5. -/
181	  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
182	  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
183	  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal
184	
185	/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
186	instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
187	    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
188	  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
189	    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
190	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
191	
192	/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
193	of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
194	def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
195	  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }
196	
197	/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
198	live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
199	def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
200	    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
201	  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)
202	
203	/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/
204	
205	/-- Static preconditions of `issue(arena, region, destination)` (§77.1, §77.2). The static
206	restrictions of §77.3 are given no list by the text and are not represented. -/
207	structure IssueStatic (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
208	  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
209	  live : s.Active E.internal
210	  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
211	  metaRight : MetaRight s E
212	  /-- §77.2: `region` belongs to the administered storage. -/
213	  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
214	  /-- §77.2: `destination` is usable. -/
215	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
216	  /-- §77.2: `destination` is a leaf. -/
217	  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
218	  /-- §77.2: `destination` holds no active authority. -/
219	  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
220	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
221	  /-- §77.2: `destination` can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. -/
222	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst

226	/-- Decidability of `IssueStatic` (§77). -/
227	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
228	    Decidable (IssueStatic s E region dst) :=
229	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
230	    (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
231	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
232	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
233	    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ dst ∉ region)
234	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
235	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

237	/-- §77.5: the effective mode of `internal` permits `Modify` on every leaf of the region. -/
238	def IssueRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
239	  ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s E.internal l) .modify

243	  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

245	/-- Kernel part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect): a block authority of fresh identity
246	`|A|`, derived from `internal`, of mode `Modify`, on the region, held by `destination`, which
247	receives the corresponding anchor; only leaf `destination` becomes `Init`. -/
248	def issueKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
249	  { s with
250	    A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩]
251	    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ [s.A.length] else s.D q
252	    I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l }

255	`available`; the issuance joins `issued` with its authority. -/
256	def issueMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : ArenaEntry :=
257	  { E with

262	structure IssueArrival (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
263	  /-- §77.3: `AnchorOrder` for the new anchor of `destination`, in the resulting state. -/
264	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length

266	  /-- §77.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
267	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst)
268	  /-- §77.6, O8.5: `destination` remains under exercisable `Modify` in the resulting state. -/
269	  keepsDst : HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst

271	/-- Decidability of `IssueArrival` (§77). -/
272	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
273	    Decidable (IssueArrival s E region dst) :=
274	  decidable_of_iff (EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
275	      ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst) ∧
276	    HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst)
277	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩
278	
279	/-- Library state after an `ok` issue of entry `i` (§77, `ok` effect). -/
280	def issueL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : LState :=
281	  ⟨issueKEff L.kern E region dst, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩
282	
283	/-- The contract of `issue` on entry `i` (§77, §58): `reject` when the entry is missing or a
284	static precondition fails; `fail`, the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable (§77.4);
285	`reject` when the effective right (§77.5) or a check on the resulting state (§77.3, §77.6)
286	fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
287	inductive IssueC (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
288	    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
289	  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueC i region dst L .reject
290	  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
291	      IssueC i region dst L .reject
292	  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
293	      ¬ Avail E region → IssueC i region dst L .fail
294	  | noRight {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
295	      Avail E region → ¬ IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueC i region dst L .reject
296	  | noArrival {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
297	      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → ¬ IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
298	      IssueC i region dst L .reject
299	  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
300	      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
301	      IssueC i region dst L (.ok (issueL L i E region dst))
302	
303	/-- `issue` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §77): its static checks, then the availability
304	`fail` (§77.4), then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh
305	identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8); the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
306	inductive IssueD (k : K) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
307	    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
308	  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
309	  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
310	      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
311	  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
312	      ¬ Avail E region → IssueD k i region dst L .fail
313	  | split {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
314	      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern .reject →
315	      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
316	  | store {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
317	      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
318	      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
319	  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
320	      IssueStatic L.kern E region dst → Avail E region →
321	      SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
322	      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
323	      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩)

325	/-! ## O19 `reset` (§78) -/
326	
327	/-- §78.3: no still-usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of
328	`internal`. Dependencies of contained values are covered since parts are places. -/
329	def ResetNoDeps (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
330	  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, E.internal ∉ s.ancs x
331	
332	/-- Decidability of `ResetNoDeps` (§78.3). -/
333	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetNoDeps s E) := by
334	  unfold ResetNoDeps; infer_instance
335	
336	/-- Preconditions of `reset(arena)` (§78). "`internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain
337	valid" (§78.1) and "validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied" (§78.3) name no
338	checkable condition beyond `ArenaInv` and are not represented. -/
339	structure ResetPre (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
340	  /-- §78.1: the entry is live. -/
341	  live : s.Active E.internal
342	  /-- §78.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
343	  metaRight : MetaRight s E
344	  /-- §78.2: no active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the storage. -/
345	  noCover : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
346	    ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage
347	  /-- §78.3: no usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal`. -/
348	  noDeps : ResetNoDeps s E
349	
350	/-- Decidability of `ResetPre` (§78). -/
351	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetPre s E) :=
352	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
353	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
354	      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ ResetNoDeps s E)
355	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩
356	
357	/-- Kernel part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, Part XIV): the record of the `Modify`
358	derivation of `internal` over all the storage, already released; no leaf becomes `Init`. -/
359	def resetKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : S3 :=
360	  { s with A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint s.P E.storage, .frame s.top, false⟩] }
361	
362	/-- Metadata part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, §46): all leaves of the storage
363	become available; `issued` is cleared. -/
364	def resetMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : ArenaEntry :=
365	  { E with available := footprint s.P E.storage, issued := [] }
366	
367	/-- Library state after an `ok` reset of entry `i` (§78). -/
368	def resetL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) : LState :=
369	  ⟨resetKEff L.kern E, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩
370	
371	/-- The contract of `reset` on entry `i` (§78, §58): `ok` when the entry exists and the
372	preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
373	inductive ResetC (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
374	  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetC i L .reject
375	  | reject {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ ResetPre L.kern E → ResetC i L .reject
376	  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ResetPre L.kern E →
377	      ResetC i L (.ok (resetL L i E))
378	
379	/-- `reset` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §78): `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the
380	footprint of the storage (O1), `release` of the derived authority (O3), then the explicit contract
381	check of §78.3; the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
382	inductive ResetD (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
383	  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetD i L .reject
384	  | derive {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
385	      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject →
386	      ResetD i L .reject
387	  | release {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
388	      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
389	      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → ResetD i L .reject
390	  | contract {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
391	      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
392	      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ¬ ResetNoDeps L.kern E → ResetD i L .reject
393	  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
394	      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
395	      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ResetNoDeps L.kern E →
396	      ResetD i L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩)
397	
398	/-! ## Helper lemmas (§40, §42, §43, §65) -/
399	
400	/-- `Allows` at `Modify` is effective `Modify` (§43). -/

1050	
1051	/-! ## Library runs (Part XIV, §46, §56, §57) -/
1052	
1053	/-- One `ok` step of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel step O1–O16 of non-administrative code,
1054	the registry unchanged; `newArena` with the guard of §56 against the other registries `others`;
1055	the derived `issue` or `reset`. -/
1056	inductive LStep (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
1057	  | kernel {L : LState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → LStep k L ⟨s', L.arenas⟩
1058	  | newArena {L L' : LState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
1059	      NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
1060	  | issue {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} :
1061	      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
1062	  | reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} : ResetD i L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
1063	
1064	/-- One `ok` step of a library run in which `newArena` registers without the guard of §56
1065	(§76.4 removed, the other preconditions of §76 kept). -/
1066	inductive LStepNG (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
1067	  | kernel {L : LState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → LStepNG k L ⟨s', L.arenas⟩
1068	  | newArena {L : LState} {st i : Nat} : NewArenaBase L.kern st i →
1069	      LStepNG k L (newArenaEff L st i)
1070	  | issue {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} :
1071	      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') → LStepNG k L L'
1072	  | reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} : ResetD i L (.ok L') → LStepNG k L L'
1073	
1074	/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps (Part
1075	XIV). -/
1076	inductive LReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : LState → Prop where
1077	  | init : LReach k statics (LState.init statics)
1078	  | step {L L' : LState} : LReach k statics L → LStep k L L' → LReach k statics L'
1079	
1080	/-- Library states reachable when `newArena` registers without the guard of §56. -/
1081	inductive LReachNG (k : K) (statics : Statics) : LState → Prop where
1082	  | init : LReachNG k statics (LState.init statics)
1083	  | step {L L' : LState} : LReachNG k statics L → LStepNG k L L' → LReachNG k statics L'
1084	
1085	/-- Finite sequences of library steps (Part XIV, §46). -/
1086	inductive LRun (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
1087	  | refl (L : LState) : LRun k L L
1088	  | tail {L L' L'' : LState} : LRun k L L' → LStep k L' L'' → LRun k L L''
1089	
1090	/-- `newArena` changes no kernel component (Part XIV, §76 `ok` effect: registering the entry
1091	fabricates no place, access right or `Init` state). -/
1092	theorem newArena_kernel {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} {L L' : LState}
1093	    (h : NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')) : L'.kern = L.kern := by
1094	  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
1095	
1096	/-- A guarded library step is a step without the guard (§56). -/
1097	theorem LStep.ng {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') : LStepNG k L L' := by
1098	  cases h with
1099	  | kernel hk => exact .kernel hk
1100	  | newArena hs => obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact .newArena hp.base
1101	  | issue hs => exact .issue hs
1102	  | reset hs => exact .reset hs
1103	
1104	/-- Every library-reachable state is reachable without the guard (§56). -/
1105	theorem LReach.ng {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : LState} (h : LReach k statics L) :
1106	    LReachNG k statics L := by
1107	  induction h with
1108	  | init => exact .init
1109	  | step _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs.ng
1110	
1111	/-- The kernel part of a library step without the guard is reached by kernel steps (Part XIV,
1112	§57: `newArena` changes no kernel component, `issue` is `split` then `store`, `reset` is `derive`
1113	then `release`). -/
1114	theorem LStepNG.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L L' : LState}
1115	    (hr : Reachable k statics L.kern) (h : LStepNG k L L') : Reachable k statics L'.kern := by
1116	  cases h with
1117	  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
1118	  | newArena _ => exact hr
1119	  | issue hs =>
1120	    cases hs with
1121	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
1122	  | reset hs =>
1123	    cases hs with
1124	    | ok _ hd hrl _ => exact .step (.step hr (.derive hd)) (.release hrl)
1125	
1126	/-- The kernel state of every library state reachable without the guard is kernel-reachable
1127	(§57, Part XIV). -/
1128	theorem LReachNG.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : LState}
1129	    (h : LReachNG k statics L) : Reachable k statics L.kern := by
1130	  induction h with
1131	  | init => exact .init
1132	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih
1133	
1134	/-- `newArena_as_library` (Part XIV, §56, §57): registration changes no kernel component, and no
1135	safety property of §57 depends on the guard of §56: every property of kernel-reachable states holds
1136	for the kernel states of library runs with or without the guard. -/
1137	theorem newArena_as_library (k : K) (statics : Statics) :
1138	    (∀ (others : List (List Nat)) (st i : Nat) (L L' : LState),
1139	      NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') → L'.kern = L.kern) ∧
1140	    (∀ L, LReach k statics L → LReachNG k statics L) ∧
1141	    ∀ Q : S3 → Prop, (∀ s, Reachable k statics s → Q s) →
1142	      ∀ L, LReachNG k statics L → Q L.kern :=
1143	  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ _ h => newArena_kernel h, fun _ h => h.ng, fun _ hQ _ h => hQ _ h.reachable⟩
1144	
1145	/-! ## Transport of `EntryInv` (§55) -/
1146	
1147	/-- `s'` keeps the authorities of `s` (§42, §58): each keeps its mode and footprint, becomes
1148	active only if it was, stays held by a place if it was, and keeps an origin `o` below it that is
1149	active in `s'`. -/

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧ k.ExternalDone p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩

/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s p) (pinEff s p false)

/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47; not stated by §47, a hypothesis of the theorems on the
initial state): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's
owning static. -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead or
pinned. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pin := fun _ => false }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/

/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
carries none. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject
  | fail

/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (KB_anchorOrderHeld s) := by

/-- Bounded check `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7) (decision procedure). -/
def KB_rootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun z => z.origin = none → RHConvB s z) True

/-- Decidability of `KB_rootHeldConv` (decision procedure for §57). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (KB_rootHeldConv s) := by
  unfold KB_rootHeldConv; infer_instance

/-- `KInv ∧ KAux` with bounded quantifiers (§49–§54, §57; decision procedure). -/
structure KInvB (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1. -/
  frames : KB_frames s
  /-- §49.2. -/
  places : KB_places s
  /-- §49.3. -/
  owners : KB_owners s
  /-- §49.4. -/
  footprints : KB_footprints s
  /-- §49.5. -/
  origins : KB_origins s
  /-- §49.6. -/
  rootChain : KB_rootChain s
  /-- §49.7. -/
  rootHeld : KB_rootHeld s
  /-- §49.8. -/
  holders : KB_holders s
  /-- §50. -/
  i1 : KB_i1 s
  /-- §51. -/
  i2 : KB_i2 s
  /-- §52. -/
  i3 : KB_i3 s
  /-- §44. -/
  anchorOrder : KB_anchorOrder s
  /-- §54, `NoDangling`. -/
  noDangling : KB_noDangling s
  /-- §44. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : KB_anchorOrderHeld s
  /-- `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7). -/
  rootHeldConv : KB_rootHeldConv s

/-- Decidability of `KInvB` (decision procedure for §49–§54, §57). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (KInvB s) :=
  decidable_of_iff (KB_frames s ∧ KB_places s ∧ KB_owners s ∧ KB_footprints s ∧ KB_origins s ∧
    KB_rootChain s ∧ KB_rootHeld s ∧ KB_holders s ∧ KB_i1 s ∧ KB_i2 s ∧ KB_i3 s ∧
    KB_anchorOrder s ∧ KB_noDangling s ∧ KB_anchorOrderHeld s ∧ KB_rootHeldConv s)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, q⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, q⟩,

## 36. Shared Mutation and Internal Administration

An abstraction may keep its metadata in `SharedMutable` storage and modify it through `writeShared` to the extent permitted by the applicable rights and contracts. **Shared mutation of metadata does not, however, grant the right to create, recycle, or terminate exclusive authority over the administered storage.** Such operations require `internal` to be exercisable in `Modify` mode from the value administering the storage.

For every administrative abstraction, including arenas, `HandlePool`, and `DataStack`, **`MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable on the administering value**. The `writeShared` branch alone is insufficient. Operations issuing, recycling, ending, or invalidating regions must preserve active authorities and dependencies. Allocation through administration shared among simultaneous holders, under an interface not providing such exclusive exercise, cannot be expressed in safe code with only these sequential operations: any synchronized implementation of it belongs to Spec 2. These abstractions remain libraries and add no rights to the kernel.

## 37. Dependent Values and Persistent References

When a value depends on the validity of other storage, that dependency must be carried by an explicit mechanism. In particular, this model retains:

- joint ownership or legal transfer of the resource;
- **non-escaping** dependent values, governed by `depend`, `store`, `AnchorOrder`, and end-of-use operations; they may survive a call if their anchors come from still-valid caller resources;
- library handles checked for identity and generation upon resolution, which are not authorities by themselves;
- validity durations bound to a frame or context, without a universal system of first-class lifetimes;
- safe abstractions encapsulating, when necessary, unsafe operations and proofs of their obligations.

**Not adopted as a universal ERN mechanism:** a first-class persistent reference subject to general lifetime constraints at the type-system level. The above mechanisms are complementary; neither a handle nor a temporary access guarantees the perpetual validity of its target resource on its own.

# VI. Abstract Authority Machine

The components described below constitute the logical state of the sequential discipline. They prescribe neither generalized runtime metadata nor reference syntax.

## 38. Machine State

The access discipline is based on the finite state

\[ S_3=(F,P,I,A,D) \]

where `F` represents the frame stack, `P` the places, `I` their initialization, `A` the authorities, and `D` the validity anchors. Administrative states of arenas and other library abstractions are separate from `S₃`. The external contract `K` is a separate parameter. The internal representation may carry auxiliary information that creates no new rights.

## 46. Arenas as Library Administration States

Each entry belongs to the library's abstract state, **separate from kernel state `S₃`**. It has the following fields:

```text
ArenaEntry {
    storage: PlaceId
    internal: AuthorityId
    available: Set<Leaf>
    issued: Set<(Region, AuthorityId)>
}
```

A region is **available if and only if each of its leaves belongs to `available`**; the empty region is always available. Issuance removes the leaves of the issued region from `available`. Reset restores all leaves of the administered storage to that set. The registry and its updates belong to the abstraction contract and create no kernel permissions.

The arena is **live** if `internal` is active. The **arena value** is the place holding `internal`, distinct from the possible owner of `storage`. Administered storage may be local, static, allocated, or issued by another arena, under `newArena` preconditions and applicable invariants. `available` and `issued` remain **in the library's arena entry**.

## 47. Initial State

The kernel's initial state contains only base frame 0 and the declared static storage. Every static leaf has its declared initial state, `Init` or `Uninit`. The roots of static places directly owned by frame 0 have a root `Modify` authority held by that frame; a static may also be owned by another static, in which case its root authority is held by the latter. The initial state invents no dynamic allocation, derived authority, or implicit anchor. The initial arena registry belongs to library state and is empty. The initial frame does not exit.

## 48. External Parametric Contract

`K` contains the predicates `DeclaredDisjoint`, `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`, `Deallocable`, `FreeCompat`, and `Satisfiable`. Their obligations are specified in Section 80. `K` can neither fabricate access rights nor remove an obligation of the Charter. The predicate `Invalidates` is not part of this contract.

# VII. Invariants of Reachable States
## 55. ArenaInv — Invariant of the Arena Abstraction

`ArenaInv` is an invariant of the **library contract**, not an additional predicate of kernel state. For every live arena:

- `storage` designates an existing, usable place; the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`;
- `internal` is active, with own mode `Modify`, held by the arena value;
- available leaves and issued regions belong to the administered storage;
- two still-active issuances have disjoint regions; no leaf of a still-issued region simultaneously belongs to `available`;
- every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal` complying with exclusivity and validity rules;
- anchor and ownership restrictions are respected.

Arena entries do not, by themselves, constitute an additional storage owner. Two live arenas may cover common leaves when their `internal` authorities are distinct and their effective rights are compatible; no **global** disjointness of arena footprints is imposed.

## 56. Uniqueness of Live Administration

**An authority identity may serve as `internal` for at most one live administrative abstraction**, whether an arena, `HandlePool`, `DataStack`, or another library administrative instance. Before registering a new abstraction, its creation operation must jointly check the absence of that identity from **all relevant registries of live administrations**. Uniqueness concerns the identity of the `internal` authority, not merely possible overlap of footprints: abstractions with distinct `internal` identities are not forbidden merely because their footprints overlap. Library contracts must make the information required for this guard available to the creation operation; checking only an abstraction's own registry is insufficient.

**This guard is not a condition for any safety property in Section 57.** The effective right (Section 43, case 3) already prohibits a second issuance over leaves covered by an active block derived from the same authority. Rather, the guard preserves the **abstraction contract**: without it, simultaneous administration of the same `internal` could cause `reject` instead of `fail`, or reissue a previously released block that the first administration still considers unavailable. It creates neither permissions nor allocations and introduces no general detection of authority cycles. Its physical representation and encapsulation of library registries remain outside the kernel.

## 57. Main Invariant

\[
Inv3 = I1 \land I2 \land I3 \land I4 \land AnchorOrder \land NoDangling
\]

On states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`, the kernel guarantees:

\[
WF3 \land Inv3 \land AnchorOrderHeld \land NoOrphan
\]

`ArenaInv` (Section 55) belongs to the library abstraction: it is not included in this main kernel invariant.

I5, associated with pinned storage, remains a **specialized obligation** of `K.Pinned`, not a clause automatically implied by sequential accesses alone. This property is required for reachable states under the declared assumptions. Its correspondence with allocations and bytes requires the refinement defined below.

# VIII. Definition of Transitions and Management of Authorities

The following operations are abstract transition rules. They distinguish rejection by the discipline, defined failure, and a permitted transition.

## 58. Transition Outcomes

Every operation has a conceptual outcome among:

```text
Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail
```

`reject` means that the static discipline does not permit the step; it is neither an implicit runtime trap nor `ub` in the elementary memory machine. `fail` is a **defined failure** leaving the state unchanged; **only `alloc` may produce it in the O1–O16 kernel**. Other kernel operations produce `ok` or `reject`. Library-abstraction operations, including `issue` (§77), may define their own `fail` cases. Where such failure is provided, static preconditions are checked before dynamic availability, according to the operation's contract.

An `ok` transition must satisfy its preconditions, apply exactly its prescribed effects, and preserve the relevant invariants. No transition fabricates a permission to make its conclusion true. Holder and anchor changes are evaluated in the **resulting state** when a rule explicitly so provides.

## 59. Implicit Preservation of Modes and Anchors

## 75. O16 — Removal of Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify`, and contract `K.ExternalDone(place)` attests that all relevant external use has ended.

**`ok` effect:** The corresponding dynamic pinning obligation ends, without itself modifying values, their initialization, or their access authorities. Static obligations are not removed by this operation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

**Associated static rule (`StaticPinnedBottom`):** Statics designated by `K.Pinned` must be places **directly** owned by the **base frame**, not merely transitively owned by a static value. This restriction ensures that they do not die when an intermediate frame exits.

# XIV. Arenas and Collective Invalidation — Reference Abstraction

An arena is a **library abstraction**, not a memory-kernel primitive. Operations O17 through O19 are **derived** from operations O1 through O16 and abstraction-specific metadata: `newArena` registers an administration without modifying the kernel; `issue` performs `split` followed by `store` (after checking availability); `reset` performs a `Modify` derivation over all storage—through `derive` or `split`—then `release`, before restoring availability. Their contract below is **normative for the standard-library arena** until Spec 10 takes responsibility for it. It authorizes neither new permissions nor an additional access machine. Arena entries (Section 46) constitute the abstract state of this administration; the guard in Section 56 belongs to its consistency contract. The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their library abstractions and are not defined here.

## 76. O17 — Creation of an Administered Arena

**Preconditions**

1. `storage` is an existing, usable place under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. It may be local, static, allocated, or a block issued by a previous arena.
2. `internal` is explicitly named by the caller, exists, is active, has own mode `Modify`, and `ExercisableAt(s,internal,Modify)` holds.
3. `internal` is **held by a place**: that place is the arena value; `footprint(internal) = footprint(storage)`.
4. **Unified administration guard (Section 56):** no **live** administrative abstraction, whether an arena or a library instance such as a handle pool, already uses this `internal` identity. The relevant registries of library administrations are consulted before registration. Two distinct identities may cover common leaves: this is not in itself grounds for rejection.
5. All leaves of the arena value holding `internal` are already `Init`; construction does not initialize them implicitly.
6. Dependency, holder, storage, and administration relations respect `WF3`, I1, `AnchorOrder`, `AnchorOrderHeld`, and the expected arena invariants.

**`ok` effect:** A live entry `{storage, internal, available, issued}` is added; the initial `available` set represents the administered storage, and `issued` is initially empty. Registering the entry fabricates no place, access right, or `Init` state. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

The identity of `internal`, not the index of `storage`, is the key to preventing duplication of live administrations. No global constraint requires footprints of live arenas to be pairwise disjoint.

## 77. O18 — Issuing an Arena Block

**Static preconditions**

1. The `arena` entry exists and is live; `internal` is active. `MetaRight` requires exercisable `Modify` over the arena value holding `internal` (Section 36). Mutation of metadata through `writeShared` alone does not satisfy this condition.
2. `region` belongs to the administered storage; `destination` is a usable **leaf** holding no active authority; the destination can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. The fact that `destination` is already `Init` is not in itself grounds for rejection, in accordance with O8.2.
   **Local self-blocking prevention: leaf `destination` is not in `region`, including when the region is declared available.** This condition is static and is checked before an availability `fail`.
3. Applicable **static** validity and non-escape restrictions for the destination are satisfied. The `AnchorOrder` check depending on the new anchor is performed on the **simulated resulting state**, after the availability check described in point 4; it cannot turn an unavailable issuance (`fail`) into `reject`.

**Availability and exercisability checks**

4. If static conditions hold but **at least one leaf of `region` does not belong to `available`**, the operation produces **`fail` and leaves the entire state unchanged**. The empty region is always available. An unavailable region does not permit a prior static rejection to be bypassed.
5. If the region is available, the effective mode of `internal` on that region must permit `Modify`; otherwise the outcome is `reject`.
6. The simulated result must satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` **in the resulting state**; moreover, **in that resulting state, `destination` must remain under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame**, in accordance with O8.5. Issuance into a value with a longer lifetime than a local anchor is not made valid merely by storing it in the caller.

**`ok` effect:** A block authority of fresh identity, derived from `internal` and of mode `Modify`, is issued for the region; it is held by `destination`, which receives the corresponding anchor. The leaves of the region leave `available`, and the issuance is added to `issued` with its authority. **Only leaf `destination` becomes `Init`**; no other leaf of the arena value changes initialization. Previous issuances remain intact and valid. Issuance does not automatically install anchors on third-party values: they must use their lawful dependency mechanisms.

**Outcomes:** `ok`, `fail` (region unavailable after static validation), `reject` (static rule, effective right, or anchoring not satisfied). The destination may be a leaf of the arena value itself: its initialization then constitutes **an explicit write to that destination**, not implicit initialization of the entire arena value's metadata.

## 78. O19 — Collective Arena Reset

**Preconditions**

1. The entry exists and is live. **`MetaRight(s,arena)` requires exercisable `Modify` over the arena value**, in accordance with Section 36. `writeShared` over metadata alone, even when legal, does not replace such exercise. `internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain valid.
2. **No active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the administered storage.** A derived authority with an empty footprint does not, by itself, block `reset`.
3. No still-usable place depends, directly or transitively, on an anchor in the **strict origin subtree of `internal`** (`internal` itself is excluded). Under precondition 2 and invariant I3, this condition follows from the absence of active descendants covering the storage, and remains explicit in the abstraction contract. Validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied.

**`ok` effect:** All **leaves** of the administered storage become available again, and the issuance list is cleared under the arena contract. No still-active derived authority covering those leaves may remain, by precondition 2; an empty-footprint derivative may remain active without designating any recycled leaf. **No leaf is made `Init` by `reset`**, including in the arena value. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

Safe reuse after `reset` requires that previous issuances **covering recycled leaves**, and the dependencies on which their validity rests, have effectively ceased preventing their reuse. Any active empty-footprint derivatives cover none of those leaves. A historically issued region does not remain permanently unavailable solely for that reason.

# XV. Transitive Dependencies, Returns, and Value Behavior

Dependent values may survive transfers and calls only if the required anchors and rights remain valid. Second-class access does not imply an arbitrary persistent reference.
## 86. Arena, Active Views, and Reset

Two disjoint issued regions may be used simultaneously with valid derived rights. `reset` is rejected while an issuance or active dependency would make recycling unsafe; after a legal end of use for all the relevant blocks, the region may be reissued. Reissuance does not permit reading a former logical value without the required initialization.

## 87. Pinning an In-Place Value

A pinned in-place leaf cannot be physically moved by `transfer`. If only an allocation owned by a value is pinned, transfer of that value may remain valid when the other conditions hold, because the owned allocation is not physically moved.

## 88. Local Self-Blocking and Indirect Cycles

An authority stored by `transfer` in a place that would then become its new holder cannot cover any leaf of that place. Likewise, `issue` cannot issue into a leaf belonging to the issued region, **or into a destination that would no longer be exercisable in `Modify` in the resulting state** (O8.5). These restrictions do not promise general freedom from authority cycles: indirect blocking compatible with safety may remain.

## 89. Handles and Persistent References

In a generation-based pool library abstraction, a handle may contain a logical pool identity, an entry identifier, and a generation. This handle is not, by itself, an access right. Safe resolution temporarily supplies authority when the pool and entry are valid; a stale identity or generation leads to defined failure. These conditions belong to the safe abstraction's contract and do not modify the authority-discipline kernel.

## 90. Global and Called Frame

Global storage is anchored to the base frame, but a called function does not acquire ambient authority to modify it merely by being invoked. To access a global, it receives a derived authority under `enterFrame` conditions and may exercise only its effective modes.
